title: AI-Enabled Creative Director (US-Based)
description:
As an
**AI-Enabled Creative Director**
, you will turn complex business challenges into compelling creative ideas while making AI an essential part of how creative work is developed and delivered.

You will lead multidisciplinary teams, shape creative direction, and confidently sell ideas to clients. Beyond using AI tools yourself, you will build and apply practical workflows that expand creative possibilities, improve production efficiency, and help your teams deliver exceptional work.

This role calls for both strong creative leadership and hands-on AI expertise. You know how to inspire people, make confident creative decisions, and use emerging technology to elevate the work without compromising originality, strategy, or quality.

Designity is a premium, AI-enabled and human-led Creative-as-a-Service platform. We help brands scale creative and marketing work through dedicated Creative Director-led teams. Our model brings together senior creative leadership, multidisciplinary talent, managed execution, and AI-enabled workflows so clients can move faster without lowering the standard.

**Why this role exists**

Designity is moving beyond Creative Directors who use AI for occasional tasks toward leaders who can integrate it meaningfully throughout client projects.

With each Creative Circle supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts, maintaining exceptional creative quality while managing continuous production requires smarter, more effective ways of working.

We need a Creative Director who can turn AI into a practical advantage: expanding creative possibilities when developing ideas, building workflows that streamline asset production, and helping creative teams work more effectively.

This role brings hands-on AI expertise into our existing Creative Director model. It is not a company wide AI systems position, but a client-facing creative leadership role that combines AI implementation with strong strategic thinking, independent decision-making, and end-to-end creative ownership.

**What you will be doing**

* **Set the creative vision**
  – Lead creative direction across multiple clients, industries, and disciplines, translating business objectives into compelling concepts, campaigns, brand identities, digital experiences, motion, and content.
* **Sell and champion creative ideas**
  – Present concepts with confidence, articulate the strategy behind your recommendations, and build buy-in from both clients and creative teams. Navigate objections assertively and constructively while protecting the integrity of the work.
* **Build and implement AI-enabled workflows**
  – Develop practical workflows for your client projects, combining AI tools to streamline asset creation, refinement, and production. Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive work, improve efficiency, and strengthen execution.
* **Expand creative possibilities through AI**
  – Use AI to explore new directions, challenge conventional approaches, and develop stronger creative solutions. Apply the technology where it adds meaningful value, not simply because it is available.
* **Lead and mentor multidisciplinary creatives**
  – Provide clear direction, actionable feedback, and support to designers, writers, motion specialists, and other creative professionals. Help teams strengthen their craft and incorporate AI effectively into their work.
* **Own the creative lifecycle**
  – Stay involved from the initial brief through final delivery, overseeing execution and quality control. Ensure every asset meets the highest standards of strategic relevance, originality, brand consistency, and production quality.
* **Collaborate closely with Creative Project Managers (CPMs)**
  – Partner with your CPM to align priorities, navigate feedback, and support smooth project execution while maintaining ownership of creative direction and outcomes.
* **Anticipate and resolve challenges**
  – Proactively identify creative or client issues, make confident decisions, and find solutions independently. Take responsibility for keeping creative work moving without relying on managerial escalation.

**What you will bring**

* **Around 8 years of relevant creative experience**
  , including at least
  **2 years in creative leadership and 2 years of hands-on experience applying AI to creative workflows**
  .
* **An outstanding creative portfolio with strong AI-enabled samples**
  , demonstrating strategic thinking, originality, and high-quality execution across creative disciplines. You can clearly explain your role, creative decisions, and the impact of AI on the final work.
* **Proven experience developing and implementing AI-powered creative workflows**
  , combining technologies such as Higgsfield, Weavy, or comparable tools to enhance creative development and production. Your expertise goes beyond basic prompting or isolated AI-generated assets.
* **A proactive, autonomous approach to problem-solving**
  , with the confidence to take initiative, anticipate challenges, and independently resolve creative or client issues without waiting for direction.
* **Exceptional organization and attention to detail**
  , with the ability to balance competing priorities, identify inconsistencies, maintain brand standards, and deliver high-quality work across multiple projects.
* **Assertive, persuasive communication skills**
  , with a demonstrated ability to pitch and sell creative ideas, defend recommendations, navigate difficult conversations, and build alignment among both clients and creative teams.
* **Experience leading and mentoring multidisciplinary creatives**
  , providing decisive direction, constructive feedback, and the motivation needed to bring ambitious ideas to life.
* **Strong creative and strategic judgment**
  , grounded in branding, storytelling, art direction, design, and audience-centered communication, with an understanding of responsible AI use and the importance of human oversight.
* **Experience managing a high volume and variety of creative deliverables**
  across multiple clients, brands, or products in fast-paced agency or in-house environments.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, along with the adaptability, reliability, and strong internet connection needed to succeed in a remote environment

**How we work**

Designity is remote, with a structured virtual office environment built for close collaboration, clear communication, and meaningful connection.

You will work within a
**Creative Circle alongside a Creative Project Manager (CPM) and a multidisciplinary team of creative professionals**
, supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts.

Your CPM partners with you on project coordination, timelines, priorities, and delivery. As the Creative Director, you lead creative strategy, guide the team, own the creative side of client relationships, and remain accountable for the quality of work from initial brief through final delivery.

**This role requires a high level of independence and accountability.**
You will operate autonomously without a Head of Department managing your day-to-day creative decisions or resolving routine client challenges on your behalf. We expect you to anticipate issues, communicate assertively, make sound decisions, and take ownership of solutions while keeping your CPM and creative team aligned.

**What this role offers**

* The opportunity to work alongside the top 1% of global creatives and marketers, in a multicultural environment that broadens your perspective and sharpens your craft
* Shape meaningful creative work across different brands, industries, and disciplines
* Collaboration with ambitious clients and multidisciplinary creative talent
* A fully remote environment with structured virtual collaboration
* W-2 role with health insurance and 401k benefits available after 90 days
* Paid time off to rest and recharge
* Professional growth and continued skill development
* A fast-moving, supportive environment that values creative thinking, accountability, and high standards
* Total compensation of $90,000–$110,000 USD based on your qualifications.

**We believe great teams are built on shared values:**

* Choose Positivity and lift those around you.
* Say It Straight with honesty and respect.
* Raise the Bar by never settling for average.
* Take Ownership of your work and your impact.
* Move with Purpose and make every action count.

**Success in this role means:**

* Delivering original, strategically strong creative work across multiple client accounts, maintaining exceptional quality from concept through final execution.
* Making AI a practical part of creative production by implementing workflows that expand creative possibilities and improve efficiency.
* Building trust and alignment with clients and creatives through persuasive presentations, confident leadership, and clear creative direction.
* Proactively resolving challenges, managing priorities independently, and maintaining strong organization and attention to detail.
* Elevating team performance through effective mentorship, practical AI adoption, and consistently high creative standards.

**Disclaimer:**

**When applying, please include an updated portfolio showcasing the work you would like us to consider, along with relevant project links, supporting work, or samples of AI Creative Workflows.**

**For collaborative projects, clearly specify your contribution and the areas you were responsible for.**

Our team reviews every submission carefully and will contact candidates who best fit the role within 2–3 weeks.

Be cautious when applying. Official communications from Designity will come only from the Designity.com domain.

At Designity, employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit.

We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences; it’s what makes our team and our work stronger.

Designity is a premium, AI-enabled and human-led Creative-as-a-Service platform. We help brands scale creative and marketing work through dedicated Creative Director-led teams. Our model brings together senior creative leadership, multidisciplinary talent, managed execution, and AI-enabled workflows so clients can move faster without lowering the standard.
  
  
‍
  
  
**Why this role exists**

Designity is moving beyond Creative Directors who use AI for occasional tasks toward leaders who can integrate it meaningfully throughout client projects.
  
  
‍
  
  
With each Creative Circle supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts, maintaining exceptional creative quality while managing continuous production requires smarter, more effective ways of working.
  
  
‍
  
  
We need a Creative Director who can turn AI into a practical advantage: expanding creative possibilities when developing ideas, building workflows that streamline asset production, and helping creative teams work more effectively.
  
  
‍
  
  
This role brings hands-on AI expertise into our existing Creative Director model. It is not a company wide AI systems position, but a client-facing creative leadership role that combines AI implementation with strong strategic thinking, independent decision-making, and end-to-end creative ownership.
  
  
‍
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

title: Creative Director
description:
**About JumpSeat**
JumpSeat is a B2B growth agency and advisory built around a simple belief: the best opportunities rarely come from the obvious signals.
  
  
We help go-to-market teams find the non-obvious signals others miss and turn them into highly relevant outreach that earns a response. It's an antidote to the automated, generic outbound buyers have learned to ignore.
  
  
Our Signal Intelligence methodology combines prioritized accounts, custom signal libraries, AI-assisted research, and 1:1 messaging based on what's actually happening inside a target account, before everybody else sees it.
  
  
We're a remote-first crew across the US and Buenos Aires. We care about bold, ground breaking work, and about the people who make it.
  
  
**The role**
We're looking for a Creative Director to lead our creative department.
  
  
This is more than a creative leadership role. You'll lead the people, the capacity, and the way we work: our two full-time creatives, our freelance bench, and the process that gets great work out the door. You'll partner with our delivery team on priorities, and set the vision and standards for the department.
  
  
You'll stay hands-on too, leading brand, campaign, web, and pitch work.
  
  
And you'll help shape how AI fits into our creative work. That means testing tools, deciding where and when they belong, and making sure they improve both the quality of what we make and the team's experience making it.
  
  
This is a senior role for someone with a proven track record leading creative in a fast-paced agency.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Lead the department.**

* Manage, mentor, and grow our two full-time creatives. Clear goals, honest feedback, real development.
* Set the creative vision and the way we work, then champion it across the agency.
* Build a team people want to be on, and a culture where the bar keeps rising.
* Bring the creative point of view to leadership conversations about where JumpSeat goes next.

**Run the engine.**

* Own capacity planning. Anticipate resourcing needs proactively and balance the load across the team.
* Know when we need more hands. Find, brief, and manage freelancers who meet our bar and our budget.
* Partner with the delivery team to set priorities, timelines, and scope.
* Keep sharpening the creative workflow, from brief to review to client handoff.
* Be the single point of contact for every creative deliverable. On brand, on time, every time.

**Raise the creative bar.**

* Own the quality of everything we make, across every client and channel.
* Lead brand development work: positioning, messaging, and visual identity.
* Concept and lead campaigns, ABM programs, and digital advertising.
* Oversee website design and development.
* Give clear, useful direction to designers and copywriters.
* Work closely with our strategy and account teams so creative work serves each client's business goals.
* Lead the creative side of new business pitches, from concept to presentation.

**Shape How We Use AI.**

* Experiment with AI tools across ideation, copy, design, and production.
* Decide where, when, and how AI tools and workflows are adopted in our day-to-day, based on one test: does it make the work better, and the work of making it better?
* Set practical guardrails for quality, brand fit, and client trust.
* Help the team build skill and confidence with new tools, and share what works across JumpSeat.

**Who You Are**

* A Creative Director, ACD, or Head of Creative from a strong agency, who has led a creative team directly.
* A department builder, not just a project lead. You've owned capacity, resourcing, and process, and you actually enjoy it.
* A true partner to delivery and account teams. Comfortable trading off priorities, scope, and timelines in the open.
* Experienced at bringing in and leading freelance talent.
* A versatile creative across branding, web, campaigns, and digital advertising, who still wants to roll up their sleeves.
* Quick to understand the unique aspects of a client's industry, culture and voice, so you can hit the ground running.
* Someone who loves growing people, and builds teams that stick together.
* Hands-on with AI tools, and clear-eyed about them. You already use them in your creative work, and you have a point of view on where they help and where they get in the way.
* A clear, confident presenter with existing and new clients.

**Nice to have**

* Fluent in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite. Other design tools are a plus.
* B2B experience. Helpful, not required.
* You've led a team through a change in tools or workflows before.

**How We'll Get To Know You**

* A conversation with our Talent team.
* A practical case. You'll present how you'd approach a real-world challenge.
* A conversation with senior team members.

**What's In It For You**

* Real influence. You'll shape a function at the core of our business, and how it works.
* Great people. A team that will challenge you, inspire you, and have your back.
* Remote first. Colleagues across the US and Buenos Aires.
* Balance, for real. Unlimited PTO, Summer Fridays, time off between holidays, and more.

**Ready to take the seat?**
If you want to build a creative department, not just fill its pipeline, we want to hear from you.

title: Senior Creative Director
description:
TAIT partners with artists, brands, IP holders and place makers to bring culture-defining, never-before-seen experiences to life. With a legacy of innovation spanning over 45 years, TAIT has grown from pioneering in rock ‘n’ roll concert staging to setting the global standard for extraordinary live events and experiences through cutting-edge technology, precision engineering, and creative design. TAIT’s 20 global offices have developed iconic productions and experiences in over 30 countries, all seven continents, and even outer space for renowned performers, theme parks, exhibits, and venues across the globe, including partnerships with Taylor Swift, Cirque Du Soleil, Royal Opera House, Nike, NASA, Bloomberg, Google, Beyoncé, and The Olympics

**Position Purpose**

The Senior Creative Director position is primarily responsible for leading and contributing to the creative development of a variety of projects for the Company to meet the Client’s expectations and the Company’s quality guidelines. This position includes managing the original creation of new creative material for the Company’s projects, participating and contributing in brainstormings & charrettes, contributing to already developed concepts by others and acting as creative lead on all projects.

This position may include the participation and preparation of other non-project specific assignments, such as speech and editorial writing and preparation, marketing materials copywriting, RFQ/RFP positioning statements, white papers and other writing as deemed necessary by the Company. Participation will be required in presentations, meetings, production meetings, field trips, research and other projects as necessary. The Senior Creative Director will act as a representative of the Company to clients, professional organizations, and the media.

**Responsibilities**

The Senior Creative Director will set and communicate the creative direction for major, multidisciplinary guest experiences—articulating the big picture in an inspiring way and leading from pitch through final installation. They will drive concepts (including major IPs) in complex stakeholder environments; mentor and manage creative teams; align with business and brand strategy; and ensure operational, financial, and experiential feasibility. They will uphold creative quality, strengthen client relationships, and represent TAIT with passion, clarity, and composure across presentations, industry forums, and solo client engagements.

* Visualize and communicate the overarching creative vision in a clear, inspiring, and motivating way.
* Lead creative across all phases—concept, design, tender, production, installation/programming—for attractions, exhibits, interactives, and integrated experiences.
* Drive pitching and proposals: generate ideas with internal teams; lead kick‑offs and creative work sessions; craft persuasive pitch materials.
* Develop, write, and lead IP‑based concepts; ensure brand/IP compliance and alignment across complex stakeholder landscapes.
* Manage and or mentor talent (including Creative Directors); inspire cross‑functional teams and model passion, positivity, and creative rigor.
* Own narrative deliverables: oversee briefs, summaries, treatments, outlines, narratives, and scripts; augment with mood boards, storyboards, and reference media.
* Ensure feasibility and delivery: partner with SMEs to validate operational, financial, and experiential viability; collaborate with PM/PE to manage scope, schedule, budget; identify and mitigate risks; respond constructively to feedback.
* Maintain creative quality control throughout the lifecycle, including TAIT senior leadership reviews; lead client/stakeholder presentations and develop presentation materials.
* Partner across content and production: collaborate with producers and the Head of Content; incorporate feedback while protecting creative intent.
* Manage multiple projects end‑to‑end, keeping an open, adaptive process to accommodate pivots and resource realignment.
* Advance business and brand goals: develop creative programs and design concepts that meet client objectives; apply appropriate brand voice and ensure brand compliance.
* Optimize workflow and resources to meet timelines and deliverables; align staffing with project priorities.
* Work with vendors to realize creative intent and resolve challenges collaboratively.
* Research industry trends, technologies, and client context to inform and elevate creative development.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures; identify and communicate critical issues and milestones promptly.
* Travel domestically and internationally as required.
* Contribute to departmental growth through industry representation, competitions, technology exploration, marketing support, and educational outreach.
* Additional duties as needed

**Position Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts, Design, Architecture, Humanities, or related field; Master's degree a plus.
* 12+ years of demonstrable experience in storytelling, creative ideation & leadership in the industry, including significant experience with high-level stakeholders on major projects.
* 12+ years of significant demonstrable major client facing and handling experiences.
* Significant experience exhibiting creative leadership in service to, and managing the portfolios for, major entertainment industry clients (including project development in the areas of LBE and/or placemaking).
* Excellent collaboration skills, and comfortable working as part of several teams simultaneously.
* Strong computer skills: Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Lucid, and Keynote
* Proven communication and presentation skills: written and verbal
* Understanding of the entertainment industry and participating in or leading a creative process
* Proven experience in constantly multitask and handling competing priorities between client business needs, organizational issues, and sound customer relations
* Possess judgment to know when to appropriately escalate issues up the chain of command
* Excellent diplomatic listening and communication skills, able to handle and resolve conflicts effectively in a firm but fair manner
* Able to work both collaboratively and independently while maintaining a high level of productivity in a remote or hybrid setting
* Able to work under tight timetables and high-pressure situations
* Thrive in a fast-paced environment and able to juggle, shift gears, and maintain a sense of humor; deliver under extreme deadlines and intense business environment
* Proactive and solution-oriented when managing issues
* Demonstrated experience and ability to provide strong coaching, mentorship, and advocacy to/for all levels and all members of a creative team
* Proficiency in English, required.
* Proficiency in Arabic, preferred.
* Ability to provide a portfolio for the interview process.

title: Creative Director
description:
Shape the visual identity and content strategy for our roster of creators. Lead creative direction that captivates audiences and drives measurable engagement.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

As Creative Director at Bunny Agency, you are the visionary behind the content that defines our creators' brands. Your role spans the full creative lifecycle — from developing overarching content strategies and building detailed content calendars to directing photoshoots, video productions, and social media campaigns. You will work with each creator to understand their unique personality, audience, and goals, then translate that understanding into a cohesive visual identity and content roadmap that maximizes engagement and revenue. You will lead a team of designers, editors, and marketing specialists, providing clear creative briefs, constructive feedback, and quality standards that elevate every piece of content we produce. Staying ahead of visual trends across platforms like Instagram, TikTok, and OnlyFans is essential — you will spot emerging aesthetics, content formats, and engagement patterns before they peak and integrate them into creator strategies. The ideal candidate has a strong portfolio demonstrating visual storytelling, experience managing creative teams, and a passion for helping individuals build authentic personal brands. If you have an eye for what looks great and the strategic mind to make it perform, we want to hear from you.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop comprehensive content strategies tailored to each creator's brand, niche, and target audience
* Build and manage content calendars with a minimum one-month forward view across all platforms
* Direct photoshoots, video productions, and content creation sessions — remotely and on-location
* Define and maintain visual identity guidelines for each creator account
* Lead and mentor a team of graphic designers, video editors, and content creators
* Create detailed creative briefs for all content assets and campaigns
* Review and approve all creative output to ensure quality, brand consistency, and platform optimization
* Analyze content performance metrics and use data to refine creative strategies
* Research and implement emerging content trends, formats, and visual styles across major platforms
* Collaborate with marketing, chat, and client success teams to align creative output with business goals

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Must-Haves**

* 3+ years of experience in creative direction, content strategy, or a senior creative role
* Strong portfolio demonstrating visual storytelling and brand development
* Proficiency with design tools (Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Canva, or similar)
* Experience managing and mentoring creative teams
* Deep understanding of content trends across Instagram, TikTok, and subscription platforms
* Comfortable working in the adult content industry
* Excellent communication skills and ability to give clear, actionable feedback

### **Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience working with content creators or personal brands
* Video production and editing skills (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve)
* Photography direction or styling experience
* Knowledge of OnlyFans, Fansly, or similar creator platforms
* Background in influencer marketing or talent management
* Familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and workflows

**Benefits**
------------

### **Competitive Pay**

Attractive base salary plus performance bonuses tied to content engagement and creator growth.

### **Remote Work**

Work from anywhere in the world. All you need is a laptop and stable internet.

### **Growth Opportunities**

Path to VP of Creative or Chief Creative Officer as the agency expands its roster.

### **Supportive Team**

Collaborate with 112+ driven professionals across marketing, creative, and operations.

title: Creative Director
description:
**The Company**

Said Differently is an untraditional agency bringing together strategy, creativity, design and technology to build brands, campaigns, products and platforms. We create bespoke teams around each client’s needs, combining a core team with specialists across our global network. Our mission is to build the marketing agency of the future, creating exceptional work through a more flexible, collaborative way of working.

**The role**  
You know how to find the thought that unlocks a brief and bring it to life. Sometimes it starts with a line. Sometimes it’s an image. Sometimes it’s an observation that becomes something neither discipline could have reached alone.

**We’re hiring two hands-on Creative Directors**: one with a deep copywriting background and another who moves comfortably between art and copy. Both will develop brand platforms and integrated campaigns, lead client assignments, and collaborate with freelance specialists across our network while continuing to make work themselves.

**For the copy-focused role,** you can build a brand platform, develop a campaign and write the headline everyone wishes they’d written. You have exceptional writing and editing skills, strong visual judgment, and understand how words and images work together.

**For the art-and-copy role**, you can write a compelling headline, establish a visual direction and bring both together into an idea with a clear point of view. Your particular strengths may lean toward one discipline, but your portfolio should show meaningful contributions to both.

**What you’ll do**

  

* Turn business challenges and strategic insights into distinctive creative platforms and integrated campaigns.
* Lead the creative work on assignments from the first conversation through production and delivery, protecting the idea as it evolves.
* Write headlines, scripts, concept narratives and other copy across film, social, digital, out of home, brand voice and other relevant channels.
* For the art-and-copy role, create visual directions, layouts and storyboards that communicate the idea.
* Partner with freelance writers, art directors, designers and other specialists, providing clear direction and useful feedback.
* Recognize when an idea needs stronger writing, better art direction or a different approach entirely.
* Build persuasive presentations and lead creative conversations with clients, explaining the thinking and building confidence in ambitious ideas.
* Help select and brief the right specialists for each assignment.
* Partner with strategy, account leadership and production to deliver strong work within the scope, budget and timeline.
* Contribute to pitches and identify creative opportunities within existing client relationships.

  

**What you’ll bring**

  

* 10+ years in advertising or brand creativity, with experience leading creative work at ACD or Creative Director level.
* A portfolio of original, strategically grounded ideas brought to life across multiple channels.
* Strong writing and editing skills, with range across brands, audiences and tones. The copy-focused role requires exceptional depth in this craft.
* Strong visual judgment and the ability to direct the complete campaign. The art-and-copy role also requires hands-on visual craft and proficiency with relevant design and presentation tools.
* Production experience relevant to your practice, including film, photography or digital content.
* Confidence working directly with clients and navigating feedback without losing the central idea.
* A generous approach to collaboration and the confidence to make clear creative decisions.
* Curiosity about AI and emerging creative tools, with sound judgment about where they improve the work.
* The independence and communication skills to lead within a distributed team.

  

**Show us**  
A portfolio that demonstrates your craft and creative leadership. Tell us what you made, what you led and how you helped make the work happen.

**Working Hours**

We are a remote company and welcome candidates based in the US and internationally. Our team generally works Eastern Time hours, and this role requires availability during the standard Eastern Time workday to collaborate with colleagues and meet client needs.

title: Art Director - all games
description:
Voldex is a leading gaming company focused on Roblox, the most exciting ecosystem in gaming today. We are home to several of Roblox's top games, including Brookhaven, Driving Empire, and NFL Universe Football. With over 160 million monthly active players across our games, we are one of the biggest Roblox studios by audience size. Founded in 2015, we have since grown to 95+ full-time remote team members across the globe.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

Voldex is looking for an **Art Director** to lead and scale our Art function across our growing portfolio of live-service games. You’ll lead and develop our Art Leads, strengthen how our teams operate, and ensure we continue delivering high-quality, distinctive art across our games.

This role is ideal for an experienced art leader who brings together **strong artistic judgment, exceptional people leadership, and a deep understanding of art production**. You’ll partner closely with Art Leads and cross-functional leadership to navigate creative, technical, and production challenges, while ensuring our teams have the right structure, resources, and support to do their best work.

We’re looking for someone who knows how to lead through other leaders—coaching and empowering Art Leads while maintaining a strong quality bar and helping the broader Art organization scale. If you’re passionate about building great teams and creating exceptional player experiences, we’d love to hear from you.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own the overall health, scalability, and performance of the Art function across all of Voldex’s games
* Lead, coach, and develop Art Leads, empowering them to own the visual direction and day-to-day leadership of their games independently
* Partner with Art Leads to establish, maintain, and evolve distinctive visual directions that resonate with each game’s players
* Maintain a portfolio-level view of art capacity, roadmap demand, delivery risks, and capability gaps across all games
* Allocate full-time and contract resources across competing priorities to ensure teams have the support needed to deliver their roadmaps
* Build and maintain a reliable network of high-quality art talent that can be engaged as needs change
* Lead art hiring end-to-end, partnering with Art Leads to source, evaluate, select, and onboard full-time, part-time, and contract talent
* Establish and improve art standards, workflows, review processes, and sign-offs that increase quality, consistency, and efficiency
* Partner closely with Product Managers, Producers, Engineers, and company leadership to translate product goals into clear and achievable art plans
* Guide Art Leads and cross-functional partners through tradeoffs involving artistic quality, technical performance, scope, and deadlines
* Ensure consistent, high-quality art delivery across all games without relying on sustained crunch
* Manage performance across the Art leadership team, including delivering direct feedback, supporting development, and addressing performance issues when necessary

* Experience overseeing distinct visual directions across multiple games or products, with the artistic judgment to maintain a high quality bar across different styles and audiences
* Strong artistic and technical expertise spanning 3D art, animation, 2D art, and technical art, including direct experience leading teams responsible for 3D asset creation
* Experience establishing technical art standards that balance visual quality with reliable performance across supported devices
* Strong art production and resource management experience, including portfolio-level capacity planning and allocating full-time and contract talent across competing priorities
* A track record of consistently delivering high-quality art against roadmap commitments without relying on sustained crunch
* Experience leading Art within a live-service environment with regular content and game updates
* End-to-end art hiring experience, from identifying capability gaps and partnering with recruiters on sourcing through evaluating artistic and technical talent and making hiring decisions
* Experience building and scaling teams using a mix of full-time, part-time, and freelance/contract talent as production needs change
* Experience hiring and managing distributed, international teams across multiple markets and time zones

**Nice to Have**

* Experience serving as the senior-most leader of an Art organization, including reporting to a leader outside of the art discipline
* Roblox Studio and Roblox development experience, with an understanding of the platform’s technical and performance considerations
* Experience working within an art organization of similar size or complexity to Voldex, ideally managing teams of 40+ full-time employees
* Experience overseeing art across multiple game genres, audiences, and visual styles simultaneously

title: Creative Director
description:
The Creative Director is the face of creative on their accounts. They lead concept development and the campaigns that grow out of it. On some of that work, they execute hands-on at a senior level. For the rest, they manage and develop the creative team producing it. They immerse themselves in their clients' businesses, technologies, and markets deeply enough to own the work and the relationship, and they hold the line on quality whether the work is theirs or the team's.

**Who You Are:**
================

* A creative leader who owns the work on your accounts, directing the team's output and holding the standard on everything that reaches a client.
* Still hands-on in the craft, executing at a senior level on the work that calls for it, and setting the bar by what you make as much as what you direct.
* Able to take a complex B2B business and find the idea that makes it land with real people, then sell it in the room.
* A developer of people, giving direct feedback, creating real opportunities, and taking your team's growth personally.
* Commercially sharp, running creative on your accounts profitably and building client relationships that grow.
* Ahead of the problem, whether that's work drifting off strategy, a team stretched too thin, or a client losing confidence.

**Key Responsibilities:**
=========================

Creative Direction & Craft

* Execute at a senior level on a subset of client work, from concept through production-ready files, taking on the projects that most need your hands.
* Lead the development and presentation of campaign concepts and key creative executions on your accounts.
* Deliver creative that meets clients' marketing and communications objectives, not just their aesthetic preferences.
* Write and present persuasive rationales for campaign approaches and defend the work in the room.
* Own brand consistency and unification across everything your accounts produce.

title: Creative Director - Growth / Experiential
description:
About Us:

**Who We Are**  
  
At Left Field Labs, we turn complex concepts, emerging technologies, and often ambiguous challenges into irresistible experiences people can see, touch, and understand. Experiential moments where abstract ideas become clear, irressistible, and tangible.

Our positioning is simple:

**We Make It Real.**

We’re looking for a Creative Director who can do exactly that shape bold ideas, tell the story that sells them, and lead — not dictate — teams to bring them to life.

Overview:

**THE WORK**

This role sits inside our GROWTH & NEXT Pods, working across some of the most ambitious and creatively open territory in the industry:

  

* Experiential environments — brand worlds, immersive spaces, permanent and touring installations
* Themed entertainment — narrative environments, attraction concepts, destination experiences
* Brand activations — moments that earn attention, build belief, and convert audiences into advocates
* Interactive and technology-enabled work — experiences where the audience participates, not just observes

You’ll lead creative across the full arc: from early pitch and concept development through to final execution. That means being as sharp in a competitive pitch room as you are on a build site walkthrough.

Responsibilities:

**HANDS-ON CRAFT**

This isn’t a role for someone who only directs from a distance.

We want someone who can get into the work — who can open a file, shape a frame, and contribute meaningfully to what’s on screen or in the room. Specifically, we’re looking for hands-on fluency in:

* **Graphic and/or digital design** — Visual systems, spatial graphics, concept visualization, motion
* **3D** — Environmental modeling, spatial concept development, real-time rendering

Both is exceptional. One is the floor. Either way, your hands-on capability should show up in how you direct, how you review, and how quickly you help a team find the right answer.

**THE QUESTION WE CARE ABOUT**

AI is everywhere.

Clients use it. Teams use it. Partners use it. So do we.

The real question isn’t whether you use AI — it’s how you use it to gain an advantage.

We want to understand:

  

* How AI expands your creative exploration
* How it helps you uncover insights others miss
* How it strengthens ideas instead of flattening them
* How it accelerates thinking without outsourcing judgment

In short: **How does AI make you a better Creative Director, not just a faster one? (or a lazier one.)**

  
Required Skills:

**TABLE STAKES**

There are fundamentals every Creative Director here must bring.

* + **Great Work** — A portfolio of ideas that live beyond the slide deck. Work that exists in environments, systems, installations, or interactions. Show us things that were actually built.
  + **Pitch Leadership** — You know how to shape and sell ideas in competitive environments. You understand what converts opportunity into business — and you can carry a room.
  + **Storytelling** — You craft narratives that capture attention, build belief, and move clients to act. From concept decks to client presentations, your work reads and performs.
  + **Team Leadership** — You elevate the people around you. Clear direction, strong taste, and the generosity to help others do their best work. Not a gatekeeper. A multiplier.
  + **Taste & Clarity of Vision** — You understand the difference between novelty and meaning, spectacle and substance. You push for both.

Qualifications:

**BACKGROUND & EXPERIENCE**

Experience across two or more of the following areas will set you apart:

* Experiential marketing and brand activations at scale
* Themed entertainment, attraction design, or narrative environment development
* Permanent or touring installations
* Technology-forward or interactive experience design
* Cultural moments; festivals, tentpoles, world’s fairs, fan experiences

We’re less interested in a single lane and more interested in someone who has genuine range and the creative ambition to push further in each direction.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $150,000-$200,000. This range is only applicable for jobs to be performed in Culver City, California. This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

title: Senior Designer & Art Director
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**
-------------------

CodeAI is an education innovation nonprofit dedicated to the vision that every student in every school has the opportunity to learn about artificial intelligence (AI) and computer science (CS) as part of their core K-12 education. We increase participation in AI+CS education by reaching students of all backgrounds where they are — at their skill level, in their schools, and in ways that inspire them to keep learning, with a focus on increasing participation by young women and students from other underrepresented groups. The leading provider of K-12 AI+CS education curriculum across the globe, CodeAI also organizes the annual Hour of AI campaign, building on the legacy of the Hour of Code, which has engaged more than 15% of all students in the world!

**A unifying approach in a divided world**
------------------------------------------

CodeAI's global role in the K-12 computer science movement is only possible because we use a unifying approach across diverse and often divided stakeholders. At a time of increasing polarization, the idea of increasing opportunity for students unites people from across the political spectrum. CodeAI's team members, students, teachers, and supporters have diverse and diverging view points, and they are all welcome in our mission. **Read more**.

**JOB SUMMARY**
---------------

As our Sr. Designer & Art Director, you'll bring the CodeAI brand to life through design, visual direction, and creative ideas across every channel we use. Reporting to the Executive Producer of Creative and Delivery, you'll lead the visual side of how our brand shows up everywhere and partner with our copywriter on integrated campaigns of every size.

This role leans toward design. You'll concept alongside your copywriter, direct the look of the work, and design much of it yourself, from video and social to out of home, experiential, and everyday channel assets. We have an established brand and campaigns already in market, and finding fresh ways to express them is at the heart of this job.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-------------------------------

In this role, you will own the visual direction of the CodeAI brand and design much of the work that carries it.

**Visual Direction & Design**

* Set the visual direction for campaigns and channel work, and design key pieces yourself, from key visuals to social, email, web, and paid assets.
* Bring strong typography, layout, composition, and color to every deliverable, and carry the work through to final, production-ready files.
* Design for motion and platform-native formats, including vertical video and social-first content.
* Build accessible work that meets WCAG standards across digital channels.
* Use AI tools in your design workflow and help the team keep pushing how we use them.

**Concepting & Art Direction**

* Concept integrated campaigns with your copywriter partner from first brief to final delivery, and translate each idea into a visual system that works across channels.
* Bring forward new ideas that engage our audiences and solve brand challenges, often before a brief asks for them.
* Art direct photo and video shoots from shot list through post, while production partners handle logistics and vendors.
* Direct contract designers and creatives when they're brought on, with clear feedback that raises the quality of the work.

**Brand Stewardship**

* Own the visual elements of the CodeAI brand guidelines and evolve them over time, with final approval resting with the Executive Producer.
* Be the go-to resource for visual brand questions, helping teams across CodeAI and external partners apply the guidelines well.
* Present your work to leadership and stakeholders with clear strategic reasoning, using audience insights and performance data to sharpen it.

**EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS**
-------------------------------

  

We seek candidates who have:

* 8 to 10 years in graphic design and art direction, including time at a senior level.
* A portfolio showing both hands-on design craft and integrated campaign work, with your specific role noted on each project.
* Expert typography, layout, and composition skills, with the ability to flex across visual styles.
* Experience concepting with copywriters, with produced campaign work to show for it.
* Experience art directing photo or video shoots through post.
* Experience building or evolving brand guidelines and helping other teams apply them.
* Experience directing the work of other creatives.
* Experience using AI tools in a creative workflow.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma.

We prefer candidates who also have:

* Agency or design studio experience.
* Experience with education, nonprofit, or mission-driven brands.
* Motion design or video editing skills.

In addition, candidates must:

* Be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident
* Work within the continental United States
* Pass a pre-employment background check
* Be willing to travel a minimum of two times per year for team events

**OUR CULTURAL PRINCIPLES**
---------------------------

The way we work matters as much as the work itself. Before you apply, we invite you to take a look at our cultural principles. They reflect who we are, how we show up for each other, and what we look for in the people who join us.

**OUR APPROACH TO AI IN HIRING**
--------------------------------

At CodeAI, we use AI thoughtfully and responsibly to support human-centered hiring. AI may help with administrative tasks, but every hiring decision is made by real people on our team. We welcome candidates to use AI appropriately in their job search while upholding our values of honesty and integrity throughout the process.

Read our full AI Use Policy in Hiring here.

**WHAT IS THE INTERVIEW PROCESS LIKE?**
---------------------------------------

Step 1: Informational Interview - learn more about the role and share your experience (30 minutes)  
Step 2: Interviews with several members of the Code.org team (~3 hours)  
Step 3: Final Interview (1 hour)  
Step 4: Reference Checks

*All interviews are currently being conducted virtually via Google Meet*

**TO APPLY**
------------

Our team will review all applications on an ongoing basis and if we believe your qualifications would make a great fit, we'll contact you to schedule an informational interview.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS PACKAGE**
-----------------------------------

The expected salary range for this position is $100,800 - $112,000. Most offers are on the lower end of the salary range and are at the company's sole discretion based on the final candidate's experience. This allows us to provide a fair and equitable approach to compensation when setting pay and maintaining internal pay equity.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees that includes:

* Technology subsidy consistent with our Bring Your Own Device environment
* Flexible, engaging, and remote working environment
* Paid time off: 5 weeks total, comprised of 3 weeks vacation annually, plus a 2-week winter break office closure (including Christmas and New Year's), and sick leave
* Medical, dental and vision premiums paid at 100% for FT positions and their dependents
* Option to participate in 403b retirement plan
* The opportunity to help students learn better and change the face of computer science

*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.*

title: Brand Strategist
description:
### **About FieldWrk & Our Mission**

FieldWrk is a mission-first B2B branding agency built for the essential people and companies who build and maintain our world. **Our mission is to help hardworking people and companies reach their full potential**, starting with our team.

We are a strategic agency that offers branding, web design and development, field photo and video production, and digital marketing services. We partner with leaders in civil construction, heavy equipment, waste and environmental services, energy, and critical infrastructure to build brands that work as hard as the people behind them.

### **About This Role & Its Impact:**

**Your mission as Brand Strategist, should you choose to accept it: build brands that create real, measurable business impact for our infrastructure clients.** *NOTE: this role requires travel and facilitating workshops with executive leaders.*

This role exists to craft brand foundations and long-term strategies for both our clients and FieldWrk creative teams to carry forward. The brand identities and strategies you create will establish the direction for all deliverables that follow, from websites, social media, and paid ads to production of brand videos, marketing collateral, and campaigns for recruitment and business development. You’ll serve as a guardian of the brand for the duration of client relationships, ensuring our work remains relevant and continues to drive real, measurable business impact as companies scale and grow.

We're looking for a Brand Strategist who knows how to get to the heart of a business, uncover what makes it different, and turn that understanding into a clear, compelling brand strategy that drives measurable impact.

### **Key Responsibilities & How You'll Spend Your Time**

**25% — Research and discovery**

* Audit existing client brand identity materials, guidelines, and placements across websites, social media, qualification packages and more.
* Create and distribute client surveys for internal and external audiences, and pull key insights to guide workshop discussions and recommendations.
* Conduct employee interviews, both individual and roundtable.
* Research and evaluate the market landscape, brand competition and each client's unique positioning challenges.
* Establish a baseline of brand health to measure the impact of our work against.

**25% — Workshop facilitation**

* Lead 2–3 day on-site workshops at client headquarters with executive leaders.
* Build custom presentations to share research findings.
* Facilitate discussion of purpose, mission, vision, value propositions and values.
* Challenge assumptions and gain executive buy-in on key messaging.
* Visit jobsites and meet with client employees.

**25% — Brand strategy and verbal identity**

* Develop the brand foundation: positioning, purpose, vision, value proposition, differentiation, brand pillars, audience messaging, tagline and verbal identity.
* Present, defend and revise strategy with clients.
* Connect strategy to business goals, recruiting, customer experience and marketing.
* Translate strategy into direction for web, production and social teams.

**25% — Client leadership and ongoing account strategy**

* Lead the strategic relationship with client executives, while PMs own schedule and scope.
* Run periodic brand and account audits that measure results against each client's baseline.
* Lead annual strategic account planning with clients and recommend the next scopes of work based on their business goals.
* Deliver clear handoff briefs to web and production teams.
* Review creative work for alignment with the strategy and brand standards.
* Identify gaps in our process and recommend improvements.

### **Your First 90 Days:**

* By 30 days: You've audited our recent brand work and learned the FieldWrk delivery method. You've completed research on the industries we serve and attended one client workshop for training.
* By 60 days: You're writing verbal identities under the Director of Strategy's supervision. You've co-led 1–2 workshops and presented strategy to clients, with moderate internal revision.
* By 90 days: You're leading workshops independently and owning strategy for multiple clients. You're leading handoffs to web and production teams, and your work needs only minor revision.
* By six months: You're working independently across FieldWrk teams and have contributed to strategy for at least one client campaign beyond the brand foundation.

  
**Requirements**

This role requires:

* 3-5+ years of brand strategy experience at an agency or consultancy, including leading B2B positioning and messaging work.
* A portfolio of brand strategy and verbal identity work you developed, with the rationale behind your decisions.
* Senior-level brand copywriting ability.
* Experience facilitating multi-day workshops with executive teams.
* Experience presenting to and building trust with executive stakeholders.
* Experience writing briefs for and collaborating with designers, writers, developers and video teams.
* Ability to manage 6–8 concurrent engagements.
* Proficiency in monday.com, Figma and Google Slides.
* Experience using AI tools for research, competitive audits, and synthesis. NOTE: FieldWrk does not use or accept AI-written copy for any deliverable work. Human-written messaging is a requirement of the Brand Strategist position.
* Willingness to travel 3–9 days per month.
* Largely available to work within CST hours (9 AM-5 PM CT)
* Strong desire to make a positive impact through design for hardworking / construction industries

### **How You Work / Culture Fit:**

* You are a great listener and question-asker
* You can build rapport quickly and easily, whether it's a creative designer or a senior executive
* You think critically, have a healthy skepticism of superficial answers, and have a deep curiosity to understand. You consider the audience, objective, content, and constraints — not just aesthetics — and use critical thinking to arrive at the right solution.
* You’re a quick learner and comfortable with context switching. You can enter an unfamiliar project, client, or industry, absorb information quickly, and become productive without needing everything spelled out for you. Moving between different clients, projects, and types of work doesn’t derail you.
* You have a “get it done, do it well” mentality. You care deeply about craft while understanding that great agency work also requires speed, resourcefulness, sound judgment, and follow-through.
* You take ownership. When you encounter a problem, your instinct is to investigate, ask the right questions, propose a solution, and move the work forward rather than wait for someone else to tell you what to do.
* You have high standards without being precious. You notice the details and want the work to be excellent, while remaining receptive to feedback, adapting quickly, and knowing when the work is ready to move forward.
* You’re dependable and collaborative. Your team can trust you to communicate proactively, manage your commitments, raise concerns early, and contribute positively to a fast-moving remote team.
* You understand that working at an early-stage company sometimes means wearing multiple hats and adapting as the needs of the business evolve.

**Our Approach to AI**

At FieldWrk, AI is a research assistant — not the strategist or writer. We use it to conduct research, explore directions, generate references, refine presentations, and speed up shallow-work tasks so we can focus on concept, craft, and execution.

Strategists are expected to use AI intentionally and critically. Submitting unedited AI-generated writing, relying on AI for concept development, or skipping the thinking behind the work is not acceptable.

***AI Submission Note\**** *AI is a great tool that can help structure thoughts, and we know it can provide complete responses to job postings. For this application, your final submission must be written in your own words and voice.*

 **Benefits**

Our mission to help hardworking people reach their full potential starts with our team. We bring together branding and marketing experts who care deeply about the industries we serve, and invest in developing their talents through collaboration, mentorship, benefits, and a team culture unlike any other.

* Health insurance (United) — FieldWrk covers 85% for full-time employees, 50% for families + optional HSA match
* Vision / dental insurance — FieldWrk covers 100%
* Two weeks paid holiday rest at the end of the year
* Flexible PTO policy — We encourage everyone to take 2-3 weeks off per year, outside of our standard company holidays
* Life, disability, accident, critical illness, and cancer insurance plans
* 401k / retirement plans — Available after three months of employment
* Paid parental leave
* Dirty boots — see really cool massive earthwork, demolition, mining, and construction projects
* Work for a company that cares for, trusts, and empowers their people
* Eligible for performance bonus/profit sharing after 6 months of employment— we believe when FieldWrk wins, so should our team
* Remote work and flexible hours within a 40-hour work week

*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each key responsibility satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

*We are devoted to building an inclusive and supportive culture at FieldWrk. We're proud to offer equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability, or veteran status.*

title: Head of Creative (Remote US)
description:
**Directive Consulting** is the leading B2B marketing agency for companies that are done optimizing for metrics that don't move the business. With over a decade of expertise and 420+ B2B brands behind us, we know what real results look like. We operate through 3 divisions: **Performance, Communications, and Commerce,** each built to share intelligence and align on revenue. Our methodology, **DiscoverabilityOS**, aligns brand and demand to guide your ICP to choose you across every decision point. Across Technology, Industrial, and Services verticals, that system spans everything from Paid Media and **Content** Marketing to PR and Paid Social to Marketplace and Lifecycle Marketing.

At Directive, we're always looking to connect with talented people who care about work that actually counts. As we grow across all 3 divisions, we're seeking forward-thinking people who thrive in fast-paced environments, are obsessed with analytics and storytelling, and are ready to make their mark doing B2B marketing that actually means something.

**THE ROLE**

We're looking for a Head of Creative to lead our Performance Design department — a team that sits at the intersection of creative craft and performance marketing. In this role, you will often wear two different “hats”. You'll be equally responsible for the strategic & financial direction of the department and the day-to-day development of the people and work within it. You'll inherit a team with strong momentum, an established methodology, and a clear positioning — and your job is to scale it.

This role reports to senior leadership and manages the full Performance Design team, including designers, project management, and motion contractors.

**Creative Leadership & Output**

* Own the creative vision and quality standard for the Performance Design department
* Ensure all work meets both craft and conversion benchmarks — great looking and built to perform
* Review and elevate creative across paid social, display, video, and landing page formats
* Build systems and workflows that help support excellent creative output for our clients both internally and externally.
* Ensure we’re running campaigns vs. ads
* Ensure we are testing & learning
* Partner with Directive senior leadership to develop our unique and ownable creative process that supports DiscoverabilityOS

**People Management & Team Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary team of designers and motion contractors
* Set clear expectations, foster accountability, and build a culture where creative people do their best work
* Identify growth opportunities for team members and actively invest in their development

**Strategy & Client Partnership**

* Partner closely with paid media and client success teams to ensure the creative is data-informed from the start
* Represent the department in new business pitches, cross-sell opportunities, and client conversations. While you will not be client-facing from a day-to-day perspective with our clients, you will be expected to meet with them monthly during leadership meetings to discuss quality & results.
* Articulate the value of Performance Design as a strategic capability, not just an execution function.

**Financial Ownership**

* Own and manage the department P&L - helping to make all budgeting decisions around staffing, tech investments, and other investments for the department.
* Monitor margins, manage resourcing decisions with financial impact in mind, and ensure the department operates as a profitable, scalable business unit with monthly revenue targets and direct margin goals.

**AI & Technology Integration**

* Lead adoption of AI creative tools across the team
* Identify where emerging technologies can sharpen output and improve efficiency
* Build AI into real production workflows — not just as a proof of concept

**WHAT YOU OFFER**

**Experience & Background**

* 5+ years in creative roles within performance marketing, paid media, or growth-focused agency environments
* Proven track record in managing creative teams and balancing creative quality with business outcomes
* Comfortable presenting department strategy and financial projections to VPs and CMOs, just as much as reviewing a creative brief

**Business Acumen**

* Strong understanding of how a creative department operates as a business
* Direct experience managing or having visibility into P&L, margin, and resourcing decisions
* You think like an owner and make decisions with financial impact in mind

**AI & Tools**

* Hands-on experience with AI creative tools — generative image, AI-powered video, design analytics, or similar
* Knows how to integrate AI into real production workflows, not just demo it
* Experience with platforms like EyeQuant, Creatify, or Superside is a plus

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Strong communicator with executive presence who can translate creative thinking into business language
* Track record of building trust with both creative practitioners and senior leadership

**What Success Looks Like:**

In the first 90 days, you've built strong relationships across the team and key internal stakeholders, identified gaps in methodology and workflow, and begun making your mark on the department's output.

Within six months, you're running the department with full confidence — driving creative quality, owning margin targets, making smart resourcing decisions, and positioning Performance Design as a competitive differentiator in new business conversations.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* We have a set living wage at Directive; The annual base salary range for this position based in the US is $160,000-$185,000 USD. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on Directive's compensation practices, job related skills, and depth of experience.
* Medical, dental, vision plans, disability, and life insurance coverage for you and your family that fit your lifestyle

  + Including a 100% employer-paid plan for you and a 50% employer contribution for your dependents
* Benefits to Support the Whole Person:

  + Mental - Access to certified therapists through Spring Health, membership to Headspace
  + Physical - Physical therapy through Omada, fertility support through Carrott, thousands of Aaptiv virtual workouts, complimentary One Medical membership for primary and virtual care
  + Time Off - Unlimited PTO (2-week minimum), Paid Company Holidays, Your Birthday Off, End of Year Recharge (Closed December 24 - January 1), Paid Parental Leave
  + Financial - Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 3% company match
  + Bonus - Annual bonus based on tenure, which scales in total amount over time

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

Directive is a remote-first company. This role operates 100% virtually from your home office. We collaborate through Zoom and Slack. You will need a reliable setup, high-speed internet, and a professional working environment capable of running Adobe Creative Suite and video production software without interruption.

We accommodate global candidates in markets where Directive has established business operations, including Canada, Mexico, and the UK. Current, permanent work authorization in that country is required. Due to the nature of this role, you must be able to remain stationary for extended periods, operate design and video software on Mac or PC, and observe and interpret written and verbal communication consistently. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities — contact recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you require reasonable accommodations in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.

title: Regional Patient Care Manager
description:
**Company Description**

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

**Why join us?**

Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now *and* build for long-term success.

**Job Description**

**How will you make an impact?**  
**Job Purpose**

As Patient Care Regional Manager, you will be the people manager and operational lead for Patient Care teams in your assigned European markets. You will own team performance, quality reviews, and day-to-day operations — while working closely with Country Managers and the Global Patient Care Head to align on priorities and ensure service consistency across markets.

You will be the missing link between global standards and local execution: someone who can read data, give direct feedback, run a tight operational cadence, and genuinely develop the people on your team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**People Management**

* Own performance reviews, 1:1s, and development conversations for direct reports across your markets
* Manage absence, availability, and team sizing for your region
* Lead hiring decisions and internal mobility within the Patient Care team
* Build a culture of direct feedback and consistent follow-through

**Operational Performance**

* Track and own regional KPIs: response SLA, first-contact resolution, CSAT, and quality scores
* Run quality review and moderation programs — calibration sessions, rubric definition, feedback loops
* Identify performance trends using dashboards and reports; translate them into concrete actions
* Own escalation protocols for complex patient cases

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Country Managers to align on priorities, workload, and service commitments
* Work with the Product/PATS team on tooling rollouts, workflow automation, and process improvements
* Contribute to the monthly Patient Voice reporting — classified ticket analysis, actionable issue surfacing
* Act as regional interface for global policy rollouts and operational changes

**Qualifications**

**What will help you thrive?**

**Must-haves**

* 5+ years in customer support, patient experience, or service operations — with at least 2 years managing people
* Experience managing teams across multiple countries in Europe (not just one market)
* Strong people instincts: direct, empathetic, consistent — someone teams trust and grow under

* Experience working with AI-assisted support tools or automation workflows
* Familiarity with Intercom, Zendesk, or equivalent support tooling
* SQL knowledge or comfort querying data independently
* Experience onboarding a new org structure or consolidating teams
* Strong plus — Spanish, Italian, Polish, or German language speaker.

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

**Intro Chat** – A first call with our Talent Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

**Hiring Manager Interview** – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with your Hiring Manager and your potential manager in this role**.** Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

**Business Case –** A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

**Additional/ Final Interview (Optional)** – A final conversation with another senior stakeholder from our Global Team.

**References & Offer!**

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

**Global Benefits –** No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

* Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
* Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
* Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

**Local Perks –** Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

**Career Growth –** We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

**A Truly Global Team –** Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

**Flexibility That Works for You –** Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

*Please note:*At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

**What We Believe In**

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

**Focus on results –** we're here to make an impact.

**Think like an owner –** take responsibility, drive outcomes.

**Keep it simple, keep it lean –** smart solutions over complexity.

**Be respectful and radically honest –** openness builds trust.

**Learn and be curious –** growth is part of the job.

* Enable growth, design and deliver engaging training (role-plays, pitch simulations, gamification) and share best practices across the team.
* Be the expert, master Perk’s products and confidently guide your team in delivering value to prospects.

Coach your SDRs to use AI to cut manual work and spend more time on quality conversations, test new workflows, measure their impact on pipeline, and scale what works across the team
* Foster cross-functional communication with Sales, aligning on goals, feedback, and strategies to maximise impact.

**What will you need to succeed?**

* You are passionate about coaching and developing junior talent. You experiment, adapt, and grow, and you inspire your team to do the same through hands-on guidance and training. For this role we don’t require direct leadership experience, but previous coaching and mentoring of junior team members is a must have.
* Own team performance: track activity, pipeline, and SQL targets weekly, spot risks early, and turn data into clear coaching actions.
* You’re a clear communicator. You can break down complex ideas into simple, actionable steps and write concise messages that get straight to the point.
