title: Solutions Marketing Manager (Remote)
description:
This role manages product marketing for document databases (MongoDB), MySQL, and MariaDB.  
  
Percona is fully remote, and open source in our identity.

**Location**: Remote (EMEA or Americas preferred, for core-hours overlap with the team)

**Reports to**: Director of Solutions Marketing (Solutions Marketing is Percona's product marketing function)

**Why this role exists**
------------------------

Percona sells support, services, and expertise alongside database software. Our software and our services combine to provide users and customers with secure open source databases, free of vendor lock-in. On this team, we help communicate the value and relevance to the people involved in deciding to use our solutions. The right person for this role thinks in use cases and buyer needs, not only product features.

You don’t need to come from a product marketing background. If you've done technical content, developer relations, solutions engineering, or technical writing in the database or infrastructure space, and you can translate complex technology into clear messaging, we want to hear from you.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

Initial focus (document databases like MongoDB, MySQL, and MariaDB):

* Technical product messaging and positioning for Percona’s MongoDB related offerings, MySQL, and MariaDB support and expertise.
* Use case and value based messaging for all feature messaging for GTM
* Competitive positioning
* Partner with Services and Consulting so your messaging connects to the support, consulting, and managed services that customers actually buy alongside the software.

Across the portfolio (ongoing):

* Coordinate with Product on roadmap inputs for your portfolio areas. Translate VOC from support, consulting, and sales into positioning updates and product feedback
* Own launch plans for releases, features, and service offerings in your areas. Contribute to launches, enablement, and messaging that span multiple database technologies.
* Build and maintain competitive landscapes for your primary areas, and contribute to the broader Percona competitive view. Track ecosystem trends across your portfolio areas (community surveys, conferences, mailing lists, analyst reports).

* Build sales and CS enablement: competitive comparison docs, pitch decks, one-pagers, FAQ docs, and other materials that connect technology to the use cases buyers care about.
* Engage with the open source database community. Represent Percona's perspective at events and in public content.

**Must-haves:**

* **Strong communicator.** Can write for technical buyers (DBAs, SREs, platform engineers) and economic buyers (VP Eng, CTO, CISO). Clear and concise internally too.
* **Stakeholder skills**. Builds trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Services. Responsive, organized, follows through.
* **Technical foundation**. Comfortable in technical conversations about databases, infrastructure, and operations. Can learn complex technology quickly and translate it into clear messaging. **Can work in, or can** ***learn*** **to work in GitHub**. Understanding of use cases that drive these buyers: migrations, high availability, performance, cost, compliance, and AI or vector workloads.
* **Open source mindset.** Understands transparent work, respects community, and describes licenses honestly, including when software is source-available rather than open source. Has worked in or engaged with open source in some meaningful way.
* **Adaptable.** Willing to work across multiple database technologies when the team needs it.
* 3+ years in a technical marketing, developer relations, solutions engineering, technical writing, or product marketing role. (The specific title matters less than what you've done.)

**How we work**
---------------

Percona is fully remote with a global team. Open source is the foundation: our software is built in the open where licenses allow, our community relationships are real, and transparency is the default.

You'll partner closely with teammates covering other database technologies and have direct access to Product, Engineering, Sales, and Consulting

Occasional travel (3-6 events a year) for database community conferences, partner meetings, and internal offsites (for example Percona Live, KubeCon, and MySQL or MongoDB community events).

**Compensation**
----------------

Competitive with market for remote-first infrastructure and open source companies. Adjusted for location. We share the salary range for this role early in the conversation.

**Why Percona?**

At Percona, we believe an open world is a better world. Our mission is to enable everyone to innovate freely, by providing the best open source database software, support, and services. We make databases and applications run better through a unique combination of expertise and open source software built with the community for you. Our technical teams are experts in MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB.

Percona is proud to be a remote-only and globally dispersed workforce – we have colleagues in more than 50 countries! We offer a collaborative, highly-engaged culture where your ideas are welcome and your voice is heard.

Our staff receives generous benefits including flexible work hours and various paid time off programs, all your equipment for your remote office, funds for career development (external training, certifications, conferences), ongoing connectivity allowances, and the opportunity to participate in our equity incentive plan. We also have benefits that support a healthy work/life balance such as The Percona Adventure Team, Work-from-Anywhere, FlowDays, FryDays, and overall flexibility. We also support being socially responsible through our PAVE volunteering program and Women Transforming Technology.

If you love the idea of working with a high-growth tech company that is one of the best in the business and known globally as a leader in the open-source database space, let’s talk!

Connect with us and stay up to date on our latest news and developments by following us on LinkedIn and Twitter. We look forward to connecting with you!

title: Director of Marketing - Falcon MLR
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

### **The Role**

We are seeking a **Marketing Director** to lead global marketing for Falcon MLR, our agentic MLR solution. Partnering closely with marketing, strategy, and product management, you will develop the positioning, messaging, value propositions, and go-to-market strategy for Falcon MLR. You will also execute global marketing strategies that drive brand awareness, pipeline growth, and engagement with existing customers and target accounts.

You will ensure seamless territory alignment and make a measurable impact across demand generation, events, communications, and digital marketing in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

### **What You'll Do**

* Develop and drive global marketing strategy and go-to-market execution for Falcon MLR, aligning marketing initiatives with business objectives and market opportunities
* Own the integrated marketing strategy, partnering closely with cross-functional teams on key objectives and campaign themes
* Create awareness, nurture, and educate key contacts within target accounts to drive pipeline growth and accelerate sales opportunities
* Develop compelling marketing content—including customer stories, presentations, web content, videos, webinars, and sales tools—to support every stage of the customer journey
* Partner with Product Management and Strategy to build differentiated positioning, messaging, and value propositions that speak directly to key target buyers and influencers
* Represent the voice of the customer by bringing market insights, competitive intelligence, and customer feedback into product and marketing strategies
* Identify and act on opportunities to improve programs and ABM effectiveness through better audience segmentation, marketing techniques, and processes
* Work cross-functionally with Sales, Enablement, Strategy, and Marketing teams to ensure optimal orchestration and execution of global marketing programs
* Build and maintain a complete and accurate account and contact database
* Measure marketing performance, evaluate business impact, and continuously optimize programs to improve awareness, pipeline, and customer adoption

### **Requirements**

* 10+ years of enterprise B2B software marketing experience
* Must have a proven track record of building global, multi-channel campaigns and driving strategic go-to-market execution
* Hands-on experience spanning GTM strategy development through content creation and editing (including customer stories, presentations, web content, videos, and sales tools)
* Deep understanding of database management, audience segmentation, and targeted nurture programs (including ABM) to accelerate pipeline growth and sales opportunities
* Proven ability to build trusted relationships and drive alignment across multiple product lines (PromoMats, Medical, MedTech) and matrixed global regions (NA & EU, LATAM, APAC)
* Experience leading end-to-end integrated marketing programs across product launches, field programs, demand generation, webinars, events, and sales enablement
* Demonstrated experience defining success metrics, tracking campaign performance, evaluating business impact, and continuously optimizing programs based on data and customer insights

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience marketing high-value solutions to the life sciences industry
* Experience with Marketo

### **Interviewing with Veeva**

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

* Follow the application process and submit your resume.
* Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
* Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
* If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

  + A conversation with the hiring manager
  + A practical case exercise
  + A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
* Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

### **Compensation**

* Total compensation: 90,000 - 150,00 EUR
* The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. We value people for the individuals they are and the contributions they can bring to our teams.

title: Marketing Tech, Ops & AI Manager
description:
**About Thunes**

Thunes is the Smart Superhighway to move money around the world. Thunes' proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real-time in over 140 countries and more than 90 currencies. Thunes' Network connects directly to over 12 billion mobile wallets, stablecoin wallets and bank accounts worldwide, as well as 15 billion cards via more than 220 different payment methods, such as GCash, M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more.

Thunes' Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in-house SmartX Treasury System and Fortress Compliance Platform, ensuring Members of the Network receive unrivaled speed, control, visibility, protection, and cost efficiencies when making real-time payments, globally. Members of Thunes' Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks.

Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 14 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, Hong Kong, Johannesburg, London, Manila, Nairobi, New York, Paris, Riyadh, San Francisco and Shanghai. For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com/

**Context of the role**

We are seeking a highly analytical and forward-thinking **Marketing Tech, Ops & AI Manager (Singapore or Barcelona or London)** to architect, scale, and optimise Thunes' global marketing engine. Reporting to the Director of Demand Generation, you will have end-to-end strategic ownership of our global MarTech stack, customer data platform and revenue attribution.

Crucially, you will serve as the department's AI Champion, embedding artificial intelligence across the board to revolutionise how we plan, research, enrich data, and execute campaigns. You will work as a high-leverage strategic partner to our digital marketing, content, SDR, events, and sales leadership teams worldwide.

**Key Responsibilities**

* AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: Design, test, and implement advanced AI prompts and multi-step automated workflows (using Clay, Zapier, OpenAI APIs) to automate manual research, scale lead generation, and continuously find time-saving efficiencies for the broader marketing team.
* AI-Powered Data Enrichment & Mining: Lead advanced data mining and account matching strategies. Leverage predictive AI and lookalike data models within 6sense and programmatic workflows in Clay to discover, enrich, and segment target segments and Ideal Customer Profiles globally.
* Global SDR Tactical Support: Partner with the SDR Manager to supercharge the outbound engine. Deliver hyper-targeted, AI-enriched account lists and custom personalisation hooks to maximise SDR outreach efficiency and monitor call metrics using Gong AI analytics.
* Inbound Engine Optimisation: Monitor and optimise inbound lead flows and internal tech stack integrations, instantly diagnosing errors or data friction to ensure strict SLA compliance for sales hands-offs. Support our digital marketing campaigns, helping to ensure they are highly effective and delivering on the KPIs targets set.
* Data Analytics & Full-Funnel Revenue Attribution: Own the data connection between marketing activities and revenue. Utilise Dreamdata and Salesforce Sales Cloud to track multi-channel ROI (including digital media, SEO, GEO, content, email and major global events). Lead campaign tracking of all key marketing programmes, leveraging tools like Dreamdata to ensure our tracking methodology and resulting data are accurate for full-funnel reporting. Carry out advanced data analysis using AI, spreadsheets and other tools.
* Lifecycle & Campaign Automation: Own and optimise global email nurture and lifecycle tracks within Salesforce/Pardot, Apollo and Gong, ensuring data quality, progressive scoring, and rigorous compliance routing across our international customer database.
* Cross-Functional & Event Support: Provide technical and data support to the Events team by building targeted list segments, structuring multi-channel pre/post-event email nurtures, and maximising database conversion metrics.
* Internal Comms Architecture: Streamline internal marketing performance reporting, building automated summaries and dashboards to keep global, cross-functional stakeholders updated on key marketing wins and pipeline velocity.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Product, Engineering, Sales, Revenue Ops stakeholders to define and implement MarTech infrastructure with AI mechanisms and capabilities for Global Marketing that enhance lifecycle customer experience, engagements, campaigns, and retention across prediction markets.

**Professional Experience and Qualifications**

* Professional Experience: ~5-8 years of dedicated experience in Marketing Technology & Operations, Marketing Analytics or Revenue Operations role, strictly within B2B technology or fast-scaling Fintech organisations.
* AI & Advanced MarTech Stack Mastery (Essential): Proven hands-on experience building complex logic, API webhooks, and AI prompt workflows, using Clay, Zapier, 6sense, Apollo, Sales Force, Pardot, Gong, Tableau, Gemini, Claude and Google Apps Script.
* Salesforce Ecosystem Expertise: Demonstrated mastery of Salesforce Sales Cloud and Salesforce Account Engagement (Pardot), including an in-depth understanding of database synchronisation, custom object mapping, system integration and reporting capabilities.
* Data & Attribution Literacy: Exceptional data analysis skills; comfortable handling raw data exports and working with multi-touch attribution platforms like Dreamdata to measure the effectiveness of marketing campaigns and support data-driven decisions.
* Communication: Fluent spoken and written English. Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly translate technical data/AI workflows into actionable business recommendations for non-technical team members. Ability to work collaboratively and effectively with different teams, sales, product and engineering etc.
* Mindset: Highly organised, detail-oriented, and inherently curious. You are someone who views a repetitive manual task as a problem that must be automated using AI.

*Sound like you? Apply now!*

What we can offer you:

* Full-time remote contract with a flexible schedule.
* A close-knit, international team of thoughtful and driven professionals.

title: Generative Content Creator

Market Development Manager — EMEA
description:
#### **About the Role:**

Hearing care is consolidating. Regional chains are becoming national ones, national ones are going multi-country, and most of them are still running on software that cannot take them there. Auditdata already powers the largest groups in the industry. The question this role answers is which markets and which companies come next.

As Market Development Manager you own how Auditdata enters and grows beyond its established accounts across EMEA: which markets are worth opening, which chains are worth pursuing, and what it takes to get in. You will shape that view with the VP EMEA and then go and prove it in the market yourself. This is a build role, working alongside the people who actually decide — no layers to push through, no waiting for permission.

**Your mandate:**

* **Market selection:** build the commercial case for where Auditdata expands next and turn it into a prioritised target map across EMEA.
* **Market entry:** create the first real pipeline in countries where we have no presence and close the deals that establish us there.
* **Demand:** turn interest into qualified opportunity across the region and make sure what we generate matches what we have decided to go after.

Who you work with the VP EMEA on strategy and prioritisation, the VP Marketing as an equal partner on campaigns and account-based programmes against your target map, the Account Managers and Account Executives when an opportunity grows into an enterprise cycle. Pre-sales and customer success are yours to call on. Product Management is your partner in crime for shaping how to enter new markets.

#### **What You Will Do:**

* Build the EMEA target map: enter new markets, new chains, new segments, and provide the reasoning for pursuing each.
* EMEA wide inbound & outbound motions: prioritise what is important vs urgent, you are the owner of your own success across the region.
* Open conversations at the owner, operations and clinical leadership levels in companies that do not yet know us.
* Carry and close your own quota of Enterprise & mid-market deals, within your EMEA territory.
* Partner with marketing on positioning, campaign design and follow-up, so demand generation and direct outreach pull in the same direction.
* Bring the market back into the business: what competitors are doing, what buyers are asking for, where the product needs to go.
* Keep HubSpot as the single source of truth, and own a pipeline forecast the business can plan on.

#### **What You Bring:**

* 3+ years generating pipeline and winning new logos in B2B software or medtech, with success cases you are proud of.
* Proven ability to build a target market from scratch rather than work a list handed to you.
* Commercial judgement: you can argue why one market or account deserves our attention over another.
* Comfort with CRM and modern prospecting and automation tooling; HubSpot is a plus.
* Fluent English plus one additional European language - German, Dutch, French, Italian or Spanish.
* Curiosity about healthcare and a willingness to learn the audiology domain properly.

#### **What’s in It for You:**

title: Interim Head of Information Security
description:
N-iX is a global software development company founded in 2002, connecting over 2,400+ tech professionals across 40+ countries. We deliver innovative technology solutions in cloud computing, data analytics, AI, embedded software,IoT, and more to global industry leaders and Fortune 500 companies. Join us to create technology that drives real change for businesses and people across the world.

Currently, we are looking for experienced Interim Head of Information Security who will shape and lead Client`s security strategy. In this role you report to the VP IT & Infrastructure and collaborate closely with Engineering, Legal, and Compliance teams.

This role offers the opportunity to further develop the client's Information Security function into a proactive, engineering-aligned capability that supports secure software development ("secure by design"), ensures readiness for audits such as PCI-DSS and SOC 2, and strengthens company resilience in an evolving threat landscape.

We are looking for a leader with strong technical credibility, a pragmatic mindset, and experience working in software-driven environments.

The position is temporary ( 4–6 months), and we are open to both full-time and part-time arrangements.

#### **Responsibilities:**

* Ownership and continuous improvement of overall security posture, ensuring transparency of the security risk landscape through clearly defined and measurable KPIs.
* Definition and proactive evolution of the company's information security strategy in alignment with business objectives and the evolving threat landscape. In close collaboration with Engineering, integration of security into software development (SDLC) and platform operations, promoting secure-by-design principles across the organization.
* Establishment of pragmatic security standards and guardrails, providing clear, risk-based guidance to support prioritization of security initiatives and enable teams to implement secure solutions effectively.
* Preparation of the organization for regulatory and audit requirements such as PCI-DSS and SOC 2 by translating compliance expectations into practical and scalable controls.
* Strengthening of capabilities for detecting and responding to security threats by promoting appropriate logging, monitoring, and alerting practices across applications and infrastructure.
* Evaluation and implementation of security technologies aligned with architecture and engineering workflows, including contributions to build-versus-buy decisions to ensure scalable and maintainable solutions.
* Acting as a trusted advisor by collaborating with internal stakeholders and representing company in security-related interactions with customers, partners, and auditors when required.

#### **Requirements:**

#### **Professional Experience**

* 7+ years of relevant professional experience in Information Security or closely related fields.
* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent knowledge gained through proven practical experience.
* Experience working with software development organizations, with a strong understanding of how modern applications and platforms are built and operated.
* Proven background in Information Security or Security Engineering roles, ideally within cloud-based or SaaS environments.
* Familiarity with common security standards and frameworks such as PCI-DSS and SOC 2, or comparable approaches.
* Experience in environments handling sensitive (payment-related) data is a strong advantage.
* Exposure to emerging topics such as security considerations in AI-enabled environments is a plus.

#### **Technical Competencies**

* Strong technical foundation supported by hands-on experience.
* Solid understanding of modern application architectures, APIs, identity and access management concepts, and typical vulnerabilities affecting distributed systems.
* Ability to confidently discuss architecture decisions with engineering teams.
* Experience evaluating security tooling and approaches that integrate effectively into modern development workflows, including a clear understanding of how logging, monitoring, and detection capabilities contribute to improving security posture.

#### **Leadership & Personal Skills**

* Strong sense of ownership and accountability for outcomes, with a clear motivation to improve the organization's security posture.
* Experience leading and developing small teams.
* Clear and effective communication skills across both technical and non-technical stakeholders, with the ability to build trust across the organization.
* Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required; German is considered a plus.
* Structured and transparent working style with a focus on measurable progress. A team-oriented mindset that fosters constructive dialogue and promotes a culture where security is understood as a shared responsibility.

**We offer\*:**

* Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
* A competitive salary and good compensation package
* Personalized career growth
* Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
* Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
* Education reimbursement
* Memorable anniversary presents
* Corporate events and team buildings
* Other location-specific benefits

* not applicable for freelancers

title: Senior Data Analyst - Acquisition
description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

**Our vision**

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

**About us**

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

**WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission**

At Pennylane, every decision that is not backed by data is likely to be challenged (when data is available of course). This culture is embraced by the leadership team, and actively promoted everywhere. The role of the data team is to make this possible by treating data like a production asset, making it available company-wide, and using it proactively to improve Pennylane’s user experience. By joining us as a Senior Data Analyst, you will have a pivotal role in large projects, bringing your business sense and analytical thinking to help us meet our high delivery standards.

**HOW you will contribute to the company**

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will be part of the Science & Analytics team focused on Acquisition (5+ people), inside the Data department (40+ people).

* You will proactively use data to identify opportunities to grow our business or improve our processes.
* You will be a real sparring partner for Sales & Operation leaders, feed their strategy by anticipating the most important business questions, and leverage your data & statistical skills to answer them.
* You will steer decision‑making in your business area through rigorous analyses, navigating ambiguity and collaborating across domains when needed.
* You will drive our self-service approach to analytics, by understanding our colleague’s needs in their use of data, and promoting a data driven culture. The Science & Analytics team is also fully in charge of creating data models in the Data Warehouse (using dbt).
* You will contribute to shaping the Data Engineering roadmap to deliver the best experience for your colleagues on the data platform.

**WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane**

**Within one month:**

* You will learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week.
* You will get familiar with our stack, and have delivered a few small projects which will give you a concrete taste of our tools & processes.
* You will be given time to meet your future stakeholders, and gain a deep knowledge of our product and operations.

**Within 3 months:**

* You will be fully in charge of supporting your area of the business, prioritizing your tasks with decision makers.
* You will be confortable with our technical stack (Python, Redshift, DBT).
* You will contribute to larger cross-company projects.

**Within 6 months:**

* You will proactively contribute to the team’s roadmap.
* You will work with engineers and data practitioners on improving our stack and data platform.
* You will share your learnings and best practices within the team.

**And beyond**: **the data team will continue growing with the company**

Which means:

* Opportunities to recruit and mentor new team members
* Increased accountability in project leadership
* Responsibilities to design and implement new processes, tools and best practices to make sure that your team works even more efficiently.

**Who are we looking for?**

You’re the right candidate if you:

* Have had previous experiences as Data Analyst, ideally in scale-up environments (5-6 years)
* Are seasoned working with SQL, DBT and data visualization tools
* Are comfortable collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders beyond the data team
* You have a strong business acumen and are seen as a trusted partner by your business stakeholders
* Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly
* Are fluent in English (French is a plus)

**What does the recruitment process look like?**

* A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager
* A case study interview to discuss a topic closely related to one of our priorities (60 min)
* A past project interview to hear about your experience (60 min)
* An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (45 min)

**What do we do to make your work life easier**

Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

You’ll have a competitive compensation package

You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

*We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.*

**Who are we looking for ?**

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

* To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)
* To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment
* To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)
* Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

**Important information for candidates**

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

**Applications through official channels only** : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

**Always verify the sender's email address**: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains @pennylane.com or @pennylane-partners.com

**We will never ask you for payment or financial information**

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to **not respond** and to **report it to us immediately**.

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

**Données personnelles**

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : **dpo@pennylane.com.**  
Notre data policy  
  
**Personal Data**

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to **dpo@pennylane.com**. Learn more  
  
**Personenbezogene Daten**

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an **dpo@pennylane.com** schreiben. Mehr erfahren

**Datos personales**

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a **dpo@pennylane.com**. **Más información**

**At ING we are looking for a Senior Business Process Expert**
==============================================================

**Your role and work environment:**

  
  

At ING, we are looking for a Senior Business Process Expert to join our COO Products Tribe and help shape the future of Business Banking (BUBA).

In this role, you will be responsible for defining, delivering and continuously improving customer journeys, operational processes and capabilities that enable Business Banking customers to interact with ING in a simple, efficient and compliant way.

  
  

You will work in a multidisciplinary environment, collaborating closely with Business, Operations, IT, Risk, Compliance and Legal teams to transform ideas into scalable solutions that create value for customers and the organization.

Making things happen, simplifying complexity, improving customer experiences and driving continuous improvement are part of our DNA.

  
  

**Your key responsibilities**

  
  

As a Senior Business Process Expert, you will:

* Drive the definition, implementation and continuous improvement of Business Banking customer journeys and operational processes.

* Translate business needs into clear functional requirements, working closely with development teams throughout the delivery lifecycle.

* Support solution design, testing activities and implementation to ensure successful delivery and adoption of new capabilities.

* Take an end-to-end view of customer and operational processes, identifying opportunities to simplify, optimize and automate.

* Use data and insights to identify trends, measure performance and support decision-making.

* Design and monitor operational and customer-centric KPIs to ensure sustainable service performance.

* Collaborate with Operations, Product, Technology and external stakeholders to deliver solutions that maximize customer value and operational efficiency.

* Identify and prioritize improvement opportunities based on customer needs, operational challenges and strategic objectives.

* Ensure products, services and processes comply with internal policies, regulatory requirements and risk standards.

* Actively contribute to the tribe's transformation agenda, challenging the status quo and driving innovation.
  

  

**What are we looking for?**

  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in transformation initiatives, process improvement, customer journey design, product delivery or complex project environments.
* Strong analytical mindset and ability to make data-driven decisions.
* Customer-focused, proactive and results-oriented profile.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to work across multidisciplinary teams and influence without hierarchical authority.
* Experience working in Agile organizations and delivery environments.
* Strong prioritization and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience in banking, operations or Business Banking environments will be highly valued.
* Knowledge of reporting and analytical tools (Power BI, MicroStrategy, Excel or similar) is a plus.
* Technical understanding sufficient to effectively collaborate with engineering teams is desirable.
  

  

**Why join us?**

  
  

You will have the opportunity to play a key role in the evolution of ING's Business Banking capabilities, working on strategic initiatives with high visibility and impact, while collaborating with a diverse network of experts across Business, Operations and Technology.

  
  

**What do we offer?**

The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.

  

Check out what is waiting for you!

**Balance That Works.**

We put balance to work, so you can do it too. With our customers’ needs first, the team´s and your own, we agree when to come to ING MAD and when to work best from home. More time together when it matters, more freedom when you need it.

**Restaurant card.**

So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn’t take up your time or your cravings.

**Our house will be your home.**

In our offices you can find electric mobility solutions, doctor, hairdresser, gym, The Good Service (to help you with your errands) and much more!

**Health insurance.**

For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children).

**Life insurance.**

We help you protect what matters most to you.

**Flexible remuneration.**

In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids…

**Free company shuttle.**

It doesn't matter where you live. We have 6 routes (North, Central, South, A5, A42 and A6) to get you to our ING office in Madrid comfortably.

**Banking benefits.**

Special loans with more beneficial conditions.

Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank.

And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!

**More vitality and more belonging**

360º care of the employee (physical, mental, social connection & purpose).

Physiotherapy service on site.

Clinics with professional, world-class athletes.

Gympass service.

Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+), Leonas & RIÑG.

International Remote work program.

**Get to know Us**

We are a team of more than 1900 people sharing one idea: **doing our bit in helping our clients create a better future for themselves**, by providing them with the tools they need to get where they want to go.

A **fully online bank** where technology, innovation, simplicity and transparency are the main ingredients, and the first one to work with **agile methodologies**.

And although we are based in Spain, we **are lucky to work in an international bank with presence in more than 35 countries.**

We are proud to have a diverse team, and we are committed to continue developing a culture of **Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging** to foster a culture of **collaboration and innovation** that represents all collectives in the society.

And even though we look orange on the outside, **we are green on the inside**. Our ambition in Sustainability is **Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey**. We are embarking on our path, for us, but we are also there for when our clients decide to embark on this journey.

**Making things happen, helping others be successful, always being one step ahead—that’s our DNA.** If you look at yourself in the mirror and your reflection matches our way of being and working…we are looking forward to meeting you!

*At ING, you belong just as you are. We hire and support people for their talent and potential — and we know that when you can be yourself, you do your best work.*

**Job Application Safety Reminder**

We’re seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

* **Apply only via official ING platforms:** ING uses **Workday** and **LinkedIn** as its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted **only via our official career site or via ING job postings on LinkedIn**.

* **Check the sender’s email carefully:** Legitimate communication will always come from **@ing.com** and/or **@myworkday.com**.

* **No payments or banking details will ever be requested:** If someone asks for this information, it’s a scam.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
**Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!**

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

*Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.*

**The team**
------------

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

**About the role**
------------------

* **What you'll do and for whom.** You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.
* **Where you'll work.** You join the Platform Team, about 10 engineers. At BLP, platform means the core of our product, not internal infrastructure: the shared services, data access layer, and design system that every product runs on. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns.
* **What success looks like.** In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Build the service that product teams build on.** Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds.
* **Own the persistence layer.** Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default.
* **Scale BLP for large enterprises.** Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast.
* **Own email, in and out.** Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including the audit trail and its UI.
* **Make setup self-service.** Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and admin UIs that customers and project managers can run on their own.
* **Work with customers.** Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling.
* **Own it end-to-end.** From the Go service through the React UI to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships.

**Tech stack:** Go, React/TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability.

**We're excited about you because**
-----------------------------------

* You have **4+ years of experience as a software engineer**, with most of that time spent building and operating backend systems in production.
* You have **2+ years of professional Go experience**, writing services that run in production, not side projects.
* You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew.
* You work well across teams. You align with product, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.
* You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it.
* You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns.
* You're fullstack where it counts: you build on the components and design system our frontend experts maintain to ship admin UIs quickly, even though the backend is where you do your deepest work.
* You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live.

**Strong plus**
---------------

* Experience with *distributed systems*, Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure.
* Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC).
* Experience running multi-tenant systems.
* Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills.

**What you'll get**

* **Ownership of visible outcomes.** The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them.
* **Impact at scale.** Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily.
* **Senior scope from day one.** You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership.

Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

Please note: Hybrid work in London office, or remote in wider UK and Europe.

title: Chief Customer Officer
description:
**Work from anywhere, impact everywhere**
-----------------------------------------

Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
  
We're a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.

Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country.  
To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.
  
We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.
  
We are committed to changing the way things are done.

Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position  
Work from anywhere!

**Position overview**
---------------------

Xapo's product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship.

Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn't yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible.

The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision.

The measure of success is a Customer P&L that grows on what members hold and keep: LTV:CAC improving, approved-to-paid rising, churn falling, and customer contribution the business can plan against.

This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep.

**The mandate**
---------------

* **Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional.**
    
  You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members' balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down.

* **Grow what members hold with us, through earning products run like a banker would.**
    
  You own the roadmap for the balance-sheet products: deposits and savings, lending and credit, and trading and structured. Each is led by a mission PM who is a banker, owning a product's contribution and its price on the balance sheet, not a backlog. Requirements go through the gate; the economics are the job. Every item is priced by Finance before it is built, on a shared risk appetite with Risk and Treasury. Good looks like products that scale assets held and member lifetime value at a risk profile the Board actually approved.

* **Win the right members, efficiently.**
    
  You own Growth: audience, lifecycle, and content, with one head accountable for the path from approval to paid. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it.

* **Keep members, and deepen the relationship with the ones who hold balances.**
    
  Retention is the most efficient growth we have. You own churn, and you own Client Coverage: relationship managers who sell the missions' products to the members who hold balances, and loop demand back into the roadmap. You are accountable for net new AUM flow, covered-book retention, and products per covered member, and for growth that is broad-based rather than concentrated in a few accounts. Good looks like falling churn and AUM growth from members who stay and expand rather than members re-acquired at cost.

* **Make the value of Xapo visible, and the experience effortless.**
    
  You own Product Design: one design system and one shell, so that members see the value of what they are earning clearly and early, and find every task simple. You design the proposition in the stream with Finance and partner with Operations, who run onboarding, KYC, support, cards, and payments, to remove friction at the points that affect members most. Good looks like members who understand their return, complete what they set out to do, and stay.

* **Build one Customer organisation, not four.**
    
  Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design come together under one operating model: one set of key results read weekly from one source, shared frameworks for discovery and prioritisation, and real career paths for the people in it. Engineering is pulled to a single ranked roadmap, and nobody in your line has engineers of their own. Good looks like fewer hand-offs per outcome and a number for every cell that its owner explains every week.

* **Bring the regulated-bank and crypto-native lens to every customer call.**
    
  You understand that a KYC onboarding decision and an AML monitoring decision carry different risk appetites, that a false positive at the gate is a paid-for member lost, and that a proposition built for a crypto-native power user can still fail a first-time bank customer. You can sit in the same room as a CRO, an MLRO, a CFO, and an engineering lead and make a customer case that survives all four conversations.

**How you'll operate**
----------------------

This part matters as much as the mandate. The known failure mode for this role, in any company, is a CCO with a polished customer-insight deck and no ownership of the number. That is disqualifying here.

* **You lead from inside the work.** You sit in on growth reviews, mission PM reviews, client meetings, and member calls, not just steering committees. PMs, designers, and relationship managers three levels down know your name because you've solved problems with them.
* **You move people with the business case, not the whip.** When a priority needs to change, you diagnose the problem, build the case with data and the economics, and show teams why it matters, so they re-prioritise because they're convinced, not because they were told. Your authority comes from being right and being useful, not from your title.
* **You have extreme ownership.** You own the Customer P&L and the member metrics beneath it, not the feature ship date. If a launch didn't move contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, or churn, you don't report "the roadmap item shipped", you change the approach.
* **You have genuine gravitas.** Senior, experienced leaders welcome your input because you've earned the standing to give it. You can challenge any executive's plan, including the CEO's, constructively, with evidence, and be thanked for it, because your challenge makes their work stronger.
* **You diagnose before you prescribe.** You can walk into a leaking funnel, a churning segment, or a product that isn't earning and find the structural cause, then fix the economics, not just the symptom.

**What you'll have done**
-------------------------

* 10+ years in senior commercial or customer leadership (CCO, Chief Growth or Commercial Officer, MD or Head of Retail or Wealth, or equivalent) in digital banking, fintech, or payments, including meaningful time in a regulated environment (banking licence, e-money, or equivalent prudential/conduct regime).
* Crypto-native credibility: hands-on experience building and growing customer propositions on or around digital assets, custody, on-chain flows, Bitcoin-backed lending, or similar. You don't need Bitcoin explained to you, and you don't need banking explained to you either.
* Customer P&L ownership: you have owned a customer or product P&L judged on contribution, balances, and margin rather than transaction volume, and you are fluent in NIM, unit economics, customer contribution, and LTV:CAC.
* Growth and lifecycle: a track record of acquiring, activating, and retaining members in a regulated, KYC-heavy environment, improving approved-to-paid and churn while holding CAC to a level that LTV justifies, not just growth-hacking a free consumer app.
* Banking-grade product leadership: you have led product management for balance-sheet products such as savings, lending, or structured products, priced with Finance, with PMs who own a product's economics rather than a backlog. Experience with client coverage or relationship-managed models for high-balance and institutional clients is a strong advantage.
* Commercial and risk fluency: you can build a customer business case that survives scrutiny from Finance, Risk, and Compliance in the same meeting, and you know the difference between growth that's sustainable and growth that's borrowed from tomorrow's risk appetite.
* A track record of outcomes you can narrate: specific LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, AUM, or contribution numbers you owned, bets you killed when the data didn't support them, and outcomes you can prove.

  

**The first 90 days**
---------------------

**Day 30:** The Customer P&L baseline is documented across retail and institutional: customer contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, net paid-member growth, and assets attracted and kept. You have formed your own independent view of where members are won, lost, and under-served, and shared it with the CEO and Board.  
**Day 60:** The unified Customer operating model is live: one set of key results across Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design, read weekly from one source. Every mission PM owns a product's contribution and its price, and the roadmap is ranked on what it earns, built with Finance and the line leads.  
**Day 90:** At least one measurable improvement in LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, or net new AUM flow is live and attributable to a change you made, not a feature ship, an outcome moved. Every cell in your line has defined key results and an owner who explains the number every week.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

* Not a requirements-gathering role. Mission PMs are bankers who own a product's contribution and price, not a backlog. You partner with Technology, Finance, and Operations on execution; you don't run those functions.
* Not a volume role. If your primary output is card spend, transfer volume, or a shipped list rather than assets held and the margin they earn, we have both failed.
* Not a reporting layer. If your primary output is a customer-insight deck or a roadmap deck, we have both failed.
* Not a role that can be done from a distance. Remote-first means distributed, not detached.

**Other requirements**
----------------------

* A dedicated workspace.
* A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area.
* Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles.

**Why work for Xapo?**
----------------------

Impact Globally, Work Remotely.

* **Shape the Future**  
  Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.
* **Great work-life balance**  
  Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge.
* **Expect Excellence**  
  Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you'll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.

At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.

title: Client Data & Insight Manager
description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.

Are you passionate about client behaviour, data and luxury fashion? Join LOEWE as a Client Data & Insight Manager and turn client data into insights that help shape business decisions across our global organisation. Working closely with global and regional teams, you will identify trends, uncover opportunities and translate data into clear recommendations that help us better understand our clients and strengthen business performance.

### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will be:**

* Analyse client data from different sources to identify trends, understand client behaviour and uncover business opportunities.

* Monitor client performance across markets, collections and client segments, delivering regular reports, dashboards and ad hoc analyses.

* Ensure the quality and reliability of client data, KPIs and reporting, helping teams make informed decisions with confidence.

* Turn complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations that support commercial, CRM, clienteling and strategic priorities.

* Prepare and present insights to senior management and key stakeholders, adapting your message to different audiences.

* Partner with global and regional teams to understand business needs and provide relevant insights that support decision-making.

* Connect data with market trends, client expectations and local specificities to identify opportunities for business improvement.

* Contribute to a more data-driven culture by sharing best practices, improving reporting approaches and exploring new tools and methodologies.

### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* A degree in Business, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field. A Master's degree or MBA is a plus.

* Significant experience in data analytics, client insights, business intelligence or a similar role, ideally within luxury, fashion, retail or consumer-focused industries.

* Strong experience in client behaviour analysis, performance reporting and data visualisation.

* Solid SQL skills and experience with data visualisation tools such as Power BI. Knowledge of BigQuery is a plus.

* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to work confidently with large datasets and translate findings into business recommendations.

* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex information clear and relevant to different audiences.

* A collaborative and proactive mindset, with the ability to work autonomously, manage priorities and build relationships with stakeholders across regions and functions.

* A genuine interest in luxury, fashion, client behaviour and cultural differences across markets.

* Fluent English is required; Spanish is a strong plus.

### **Additional information**

**About us:**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.
