title: Regional Design Producer Lead - ( Madrid )
description:
**Regional Design Producer Lead - ( Madrid )**

Seen & Heard is a global creative agency with studios in Newcastle and London, delivering design, video production, creative communication and brand adaptation for global brands. Now we're going further. This is a brand-new role and a rare opportunity for a designer who's ready to step up, take the lead and shape how great creative lands across an entire region.

**THE ROLE**

As Regional Design Producer Lead, you'll be the **guardian of cultural and creative relevance** for your region. Global marketing toolboxes and their localisations are created in our UK design hub. Your mission is to make sure that work doesn't just arrive in your markets, it truly lands.

This is a Design Producer role first. Creative judgement and output sit at its heart, with project management running alongside. Yes, there's plenty of coordination, and you'll need to be brilliantly organised to do it well. But the real magic is this: looking at an asset built for everyone, knowing instantly how it will and won't work in your markets, and directing what needs to change. That cultural instinct is exactly why this role lives in the region, not the hub.

You'll also be the person who brings the region together. Markets get what they need faster, and for less, when their requirements arrive as one set rather than one at a time. You'll pull those requirements together, sharpen them along the way and get them in on time, then make sure the finished work gets back out to the markets just as smoothly.

This is leadership without line management: you'll lead through influence, expertise and great creative judgement. It's the perfect next step for a designer with a strong creative eye who's ready to start delivering through others, and who wants to grow with our business. You'll embody our values of **curiosity**, **partnerships**, **insight**, **agility** and **integrity**, and solve problems through beautiful design, rather than treating design as just an output.

**Where you'll fit in**

You'll report directly to a Director.

You'll partner closely with the client's creative operations lead for your region. They own the workflow, approvals, budgets and reporting. Within all of that, you're the one who **owns brief quality, cultural judgement and market consolidation**.

You'll also be part of a growing network of regional producers. They're your peers, with no reporting line either way: the people you'll swap ideas with, cover for and build a genuine support network alongside.

Expect two to three days a week in the client's office in the region, with the rest of the week working from home. And because this role is brand new, you'll have room to help shape exactly what that looks like as working relationships in the region settle.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Cultural Relevance**

This is the heart of the role, and the part that simply can't be done from the UK. It's why you'll be based in the region.

* Alongside the marketing teams in the countries, decide what adapts, what has to be made from scratch, and what is not right for a market at all.
* Check what comes out of the hub for cultural fit, inside the hub’s quality gate rather than as another approval on the end of it.
* Say when something will not work, say why, and say what would. Flagging a problem without an answer is a job half done.
* Hold a position when a market asks for something that would damage the work or the brand, and know when to concede.
* Know what is going on in the region. Retail landscape, salon landscape, competitors, language, trends and what the markets are reacting to.

**Markets and Briefs**

Every market in the region briefs through you, making you the region's creative gatekeeper. A half-finished brief costs everyone time, so you'll set the bar for brief quality and make sure every brief that reaches the hub is ready to fly.

* Be the contact for the markets in the region, and build relationships with them that go further than email.
* Quality-gate every brief before it reaches the hub. Push back, and help markets get a brief to the point where it can be worked on.
* Refuse variations that are off-brand, inappropriate or not worth what they cost. Explain why rather than simply saying no.
* Consolidate requirements so the hub gets one set from the region rather than several. These requirements need to land alongside the other regions as the model expands so scale can be leveraged in the hub.
* Coordinate with the global team what the markets keep asking for, so the next toolbox has it built in.

**EXPERIENCE**

* Producing or managing creative work across more than one market, in an agency, a brand, an in-house studio or a market team.
* Working inside established creative or operational systems, and adapting them for market or business unit.
* Running briefs/requirements and stakeholders across several countries or departments.
* Running feedback and approval rounds to a deadline, and holding people to them.
* Creative automation or AI-assisted production/operations, hands-on and current, with a clear view of what AI does well and where it does not add value.
* Reporting on volumes, progress and spend accurately and on time.
* Fluent English, and fluent in the language of the country this role is based in.

**SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES**

* Creative judgement. Can look at a piece of work and say why it will not land in a market, and what would.
* Able to hold a position with a market, with the hub or with a client colleague, and to know when to concede.
* Highly organised. Several markets converge on this role and nothing can be allowed to fall through it.
* Comfortable being the only Seen & Heard person in the room, being able to represent the company and the work.
* Clear about the difference between a preference and a problem.
* Writes a brief someone can start work from.
* Generous with what they know, and curious about markets other than their own.

**DESIRABLE**

* A design background, and enough hands-on Adobe Creative Cloud to make a small amend without asking.
* Conversational skills in additional languages from the region.
* Beauty, fashion or FMCG background, and an understanding of salon and retail.
* Experience of a hub-and-spoke or centralised production model, from either end of it.
* Localisation or transcreation specifically, rather than general production.
* Working knowledge of a DAM or creative workflow platform.
* Experience of a business going through growth or structural change.

**What we offer**

* **Pension:** 3% matched contribution
* **Holiday:** 23 days plus bank holidays, with time off between Christmas and New Year guaranteed
* **Sick pay:** 5 days at full pay each year
* **Flexible working:** hybrid options that work for you and the team
* **Wellbeing:** free gym classes in Newcastle and rooftop sauna access in London
* **Learning and development:** monthly lunch-and-learns, plus funding and time off for relevant courses

**READY TO LEAD?**

If you're a designer who's ready to step into leadership, bring creative judgement to a whole region and help shape a brand-new role from day one, we'd love to hear from you.

title: LEATHER DEVELOPMENT & SOURCING MANAGER
description:
### **Position**

Are you an expert in luxury leather craftsmanship with a passion for driving innovation and speed-to-market? We are looking for a **Leather Development & Sourcing Manager** to join our Development team.

In this pivotal role, you will bridge creative vision and technical execution, translating design briefs into proprietary brand signatures while maintaining the highest standards of quality, sustainability, and efficiency.

### **Job responsibilities**

  

* **Drive Rapid Development & Innovation:** Spearhead end-to-end development cycles from the initial design brief to industrialization, successfully optimizing innovation lead times while maintaining strict adherence to the collection milestone calendar without quality degradation.
* **Translate Creative Vision into Brand Signatures:** Direct exclusive touch, finishes, color depth, and natural aging characteristics, ensuring high first-time-right color and handfeel approval rates and consistent Maison signature finishes across bulk production.
* **Quality Assurance & Technical Validation:** Balance acceleration in time-to-market with rigorous technical validation, comprehensive testing, quality assurance, and root-cause analysis for leather behavior in handbag construction.
* **Supplier Management & ESG Integration:** Lead supplier management, negotiation, and cross-functional decision-making while embedding robust ESG practices, full traceability, and regulatory compliance into daily operations.

### **Profile**

* 15+ years of proven experience in leather development, research, and tanning within a fast-paced luxury environment.
* Deep knowledge of tanning, finishing, grading, and leather behavior in handbag construction. A strong eye for luxury aesthetics, handfeel, grain, and color nuance.
* Exceptional communication, high cross-functional influence, and the ability to seamlessly translate creative briefs into precise technical specifications.
* Fluency in English and Spanish are a must; knowledge of Italian and/or French is a strong advantage.

### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

  

Are you ready to shape the future of luxury leather goods? Apply now!

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Marketing Planning and Performance Manager
description:
Just imagine shaping how the LEGO® brand builds demand across Spain and Portugal. Then make it real.

  
  

**About the role**

As our Marketing Planning & Performance Manager for Iberia, you’ll lead insight-driven marketing planning, budget management and marketing effectiveness. You’ll translate global and Western Europe priorities into commercially grounded local plans. Working closely with Marketing and Finance, you’ll connect consumer, shopper and market insights with investment decisions, monitor performance and recommend action when results move off track. The position will belong to the marketing leadership team reporting directly to the Head of Marketing.

  
  

**Required Qualifications**

* Proven experience in coordinating planning cycles, tracking spend and forecasts, investigating variances and supporting month-end and year-end financial processes.
* Strong ease working with figures and complex datasets; ability to check data accuracy, identify trends and variances, interpret marketing, consumer, shopper and commercial data, evaluate effectiveness and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Advanced Excel, strong PowerPoint and confidence working with reporting and planning systems to produce accurate analysis and clear decision-ready presentations.
* Stakeholder influence and collaboration: build strong relationships across Marketing, Finance and regional teams
* Being able to connect analysis to business priorities, communicate a clear storyline and present practical recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Prioritisation, ownership and adaptability: focus on the highest-impact priorities - make trade-offs, anticipate risks, maintain attention to detail and deliver reliably under pressure
* Professional fluency in English and Spanish
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Applied marketing mix modelling, campaign evaluation, or consumer and shopper research to guide media and marketing investment decisions.
* Coordinated integrated marketing plans across multiple markets, aligning local priorities with regional direction.
  

**What you'll build**

* Coordinating the marketing contribution to Iberia’s annual strategy, bringing together insights and priorities to shape a coherent plan aligned with business objectives and Western Europe direction.
* Optimising marketing budgets throughout the year, allocating and reallocating investment in line with strategic priorities and business performance to focus resources where they can have the greatest impact.
* Balancing brand-building priorities, commercial objectives and budget constraints, including recommendations to address gaps to target.
* Translating complex performance data and marketing effectiveness findings into practical investment choices and clear stakeholder narratives.
* Improving planning tools, data quality and ways of working while building shared ownership of performance and continuous learning.
  

  

If you’ve owned a marketing budget or planning cycle and used performance data to change an investment decision, you’ll feel at home here. What matters most is making complex findings clear, practical and useful.

  
  

**Life on the team**

You’ll join the Iberia Marketing team, which creates demand through locally relevant programmes grounded in consumer, shopper and commercial understanding. You’ll collaborate across Brand Marketing, Digital Media, Brand Relations, Trade Marketing and Finance. You’ll take ownership, manage competing priorities and communicate clear storylines, while constructively challenging requests when focus is needed.

  
  

**What success looks like**

You’ll create transparent budgets, reliable planning routines and timely performance reviews that lead to action. As the team strengthens integrated planning across Spain and Portugal, you’ll help embed marketing effectiveness and consumer insights into investment discussions. You’ll work closely with the Head of Marketing, the Marketing Leadership Team, Finance, Western Europe peers, insight specialists, the Marketing Effectiveness team and external agencies.

description:

**Manager, Strategy & Execution**

Do you want to lead projects that influence the future direction of global business? Are you curious about how to keep a strategy alive across a global organization? Are you excited by working closely with experienced leaders to solve the most challenging problems in our business? Then you might be who we are looking for!

You will be part of our Strategy & Execution team and work on high-impact, cross-functional projects that help drive STG's strategy forward. You will work directly with the Head of Strategy and the rest of the team, partnering closely with business leaders and subject matter experts across the organization. You can expect to spend your time both supporting the Executive Board decision-making, and working with the business to drive execution. Your contributions will drive strategic initiatives, bring new clarity to complex problems, align stakeholders through challenging trade-offs and ultimately help STG deliver our strategic ambitions. Our team are the stewards of the Focus2030 strategy, and you will play a core part in keeping the strategy alive in the business while remaining responsive to market changes and execution learnings.

This would be an ideal role for an associate-manager level consultant looking to transition into a corporate role so they can take longer term ownership of their projects and see them come to life.

  

**What your day will look like**

As a Manager in the Strategy & Execution team, you can expect to work across a wide range of projects and initiatives. Example projects could include:

* Preparing materials for the Board of Directors strategy days
* Developing a methodology to define future market roles
* Building a business case to optimise our product portfolio to maximise growth and operational efficiency
* Supporting a business team to prioritise their focus areas for the strategy period
* Reviewing our progress to delivering our strategy for the Exec Board
* Creating a new Exec Board KPI dashboard to continuously monitor the success of strategy execution
* Developing a comms plan for Focus2030

Your role will vary from developing content yourself to collaborating closely with others, depending on the project or business needs. Your role will often include:

* Project managing complex, cross-functional projects
* Creating insightful analysis (gathering, testing, combining, summarising, visualising)
* Developing frameworks to bring simplicity and clarity to complex problems and decisions
* Working closely with experts and stakeholders to identify and refine recommendations
* Running workshops with senior leaders
* Building slide decks to tell a compelling message
* Managing and supporting the development of more junior team member(s)
  

**What you’ll bring**

* You will bring a minimum of 3-4 years of strategy and/or management consulting experience
  + Experience in a corporate environment (permanent or secondments) is a plus
* Problem and decision structuring – experience building frameworks to simplify challenges and decisions to enable the business to move forward
* Experience in Consumer-Packaged Goods and/or Retail sectors
* Demonstrated project management experience and attention to detail
* Strong stakeholder management and team working experience
* Demonstrated strong analytical skills including experience delivering complex analyses in Excel
  + Understanding P&L / key accounting principles / Cashflow modelling is a plus
  + Understanding of data structuring principles and leveraging multiple data sources a plus
* Good slide development skills (storyboarding, content development, polishing) for C-level messaging
* A learning and growth mindset – developing yourself and supporting the development of the team around you
* Experience and curiosity in using GenAi tools to accelerate and improve your work, including effective prompting, iterative refinement and critical evaluation of AI outputs
* Professionally fluent in English
  

**What you’ll learn**

* There will be a strong investment in your development where you need it, with a variety of experiences and supportive coaching
* This could include:
  + Deepening your experience in the CPG / Retail sector
  + Refining your presentation skills, to communicate complex topics in a clear and effective way
  + Leading projects that are critical to our strategy success
  + Strengthening your stakeholder management skills in a complex, cross-functional, international organization
* This role will give exposure to senior leaders across business globally and equip you to be a transformation leader with extensive experience working alongside C-suite
* Our Strategy department, which brings together teams focused on strategy execution, consumer insights, business intelligence, data, and sustainability, will provide you with an opportunity to broaden your expertise across these disciplines too
  

**Working at STG & What to expect**

At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next. At STG you'll find more than a role—you'll find opportunities to grow, collaborate across borders, and make a meaningful impact. Our Strategy team brings together over 15 nationalities and 20 languages, for a culturally rich and diverse environment.

We work flexibly and understand the importance of balancing work with your personal life. At the same time, collaboration is a key part of how we work, so you can expect to be in our office in Gentofte or Alcantra at least 3 days per week.

* Proven leadership and stakeholder management capabilities, with strong communication, collaboration, and influencing skills across cross-functional teams.

title: Regional People Partner - Europe Major Markets
description:
### **Description**

As an accredited Living Wage employer, we put our people first and fight cruel practices like animal testing, promote regeneration, and show that it is what’s inside that counts - whether that’s an ingredient in a product, or the minerals in a smartphone.

**Role overview:**

Develop meaningful and mutually beneficial relationships between people practices and commercial business success across our European major markets. Engage with regional leaders, country managers, and business partners. Deliver change and transformation, taking the lead in people related projects with a broad and objective view of the impact across diverse business areas and geographies within the region.

This role involves direct line management and leadership of People Leads across our European entities. Driving regional alignment, operational consistency, and team development. You will utilise sound knowledge of Lush people principles and best practices, working collaboratively and proactively with other members of the global and regional people team on cross functional projects, in support of colleagues doing their best work across multiple markets.

**Office Location:** This role will support our colleagues in France, Germany, Italy and Spain and ideally you're main location of work will be Paris, Berlin, Milan or Madrid.

**Business Travel:** As this role will be supporting France, Germany, Italy and Spain, travelling will be a requirement.  
  
**Please note: We may close this vacancy early if we receive an overwhelming response or our business requirements change.**

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Directly line manage and empower the People Leads across European entities, fostering their growth, setting clear operational standards, and ensuring strong local HR delivery.
* Work alongside the Leader/Director, FBP, and their team on a wide range of topics, such as change management, projects, organisational design, recruitment, training and development, and communications.

* Connect regularly with the People Discipline Leads creating alignment in standards of staff experience in recruitment, onboarding, training, pay, and development while respecting and adapting to local cultural and regulatory nuances within the region.

Establishing needs, proposing solutions, and monitoring effectiveness to get the best possible return for the business area while managing regional complexity and local implementation.

* Proactively anticipate issues before they happen and act for prevention, particularly regarding cross border people movement and regulatory changes across European markets.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* Minimum of 5 years of HR/People Partnering experience, ideally within a multi site retail, commercial, or multinational environment.
* Proven track record in line managing, coaching, and developing HR/People leads across international or multi entity business models.
* Broad understanding of the commercial landscape within Europe with a drive to help others understand it too.
* Solid working knowledge of French employment law is highly beneficial. Familiarity with employment law in other key European markets is desirable, though core knowledge across other jurisdictions can be taught and supported by local specialists.
* Experience in, or strong capability to navigate:
  + Works Councils (Comité Social et Économique / Betriebsrat) in France and Germany.
  + Trade Unions & Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBA / CCN) in Spain and Italy (e.g., *Convenio Colectivo*, *Contratto Collettivo Nazionale di Lavoro*).
* Trusted relationship with the Director/s, with a track record of providing useful advice and recommendations on people matters.
* Act with kindness, integrity, and respect.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to make decisions independently.
* Informed, relevant, and up to date with the business and team sentiment across the region.
* High emotional intelligence with the ability to think quickly and sensitively in a culturally diverse environment.
* Demonstrable ability to influence, challenge, and negotiate with management at all levels and execute with excellence.
* Excellent ability to navigate multiple perspectives and stakeholders to deliver action that works for everyone.
* Desire to represent a professional and fair approach.
* Strong ability to constantly assess and prioritise the needs of the business and individuals.
* Positive attitude, motivated, action oriented.
* Able to support the growth and development of individuals at all levels.
* Competent in recruiting, interviewing, career conversations in addition to performance management, sensitive feedback, or exit conversations.
* Commercially minded, analytical, and objective, with a strong grasp of regional market data and trends.
* Collaborate closely with other People disciplines to ensure support for all employees, including Talent, Global Mobility, Pay and Benefits, ED&I, People Support, and L&D.

**Languages**

* Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required.
* Professional fluency in one or more major European languages (French, German, Spanish, or Italian) is strongly preferred to effectively manage localised People Leads and partner with regional stakeholders across key entities.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Bonus scheme
* Day off for weekday birthdays
* A generous discount on Lush products and spa treatments
* Employee assistance programme
* We’re 10% Employee Owned - all colleagues play a role in protecting our ethics, our independence, contributing ideas for the future and share in the rewards of success when the company is doing well.
* Access to employee-led Community Networks, including Disability and Chronic Illness, Family Support, Global Majority (Race and Ethnicity), LGBTQIA+, Menopause and Neurodiversity communities.

Localised benefits can be discussed in more detail during the recruitment process.

We believe that your information is yours and that it is Lush's responsibility to process your personal information in a secure, fair and accurate manner. Every individual processed by LUSH has certain rights over their data, which are detailed in our Privacy Notice here.

### **About Lush**

Since establishing in 1995 in Poole, Dorset, Lush has been driven by innovation and its ethics.  
Creators of pioneering beauty products such as the fizzing bath bomb, shower jellies and solid shampoo bars, we place emphasis on fresh ingredients like organic fruits and vegetables, fight against animal testing and combat over-packaging by developing products that can be sold ‘naked’ to the customer without any packaging.

Through our separate business divisions we invent, manufacture and sell our handmade products direct to our customers through our own shops and online. The fact that we make all our products by hand is something we are really rather proud of!  
  
Lush is 10% Employee Owned since 2017 and our people are the heart and soul of our business.

* operation and organization of the Laboratories and common areas of the Unit, and

**Everything you are looking for and more**

At InPost, we are looking for a Regional Security Manager to lead and drive our security strategy across Spain and Portugal, ensuring the protection of our people, assets, facilities and operations.

Reporting to the Security Director Iberia, you will play a key role in strengthening security standards across our network, managing risks and ensuring business continuity in a dynamic logistics environment. You will oversee physical and electronic security, lead security teams and external providers, manage the departmental budget, and ensure compliance with applicable legislation and InPost Group standards.

This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on operational responsibility, including security systems management, incident investigations, site audits and collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

Based in San Fernando de Henares (Madrid), you will travel frequently across Spain and Portugal, covering approximately 50% of the Iberian territory. Availability outside regular working hours and on-call support will also be required.

**What responsibilities and objectives will you have?**

* **Security Strategy & Risk Management:** Define and implement the security strategy for the assigned Iberian territory, aligned with InPost Group objectives. Identify, assess and mitigate risks across facilities, transportation and operational processes, ensuring business continuity and resilience.
* **Team Leadership & Workforce Management:** Lead, develop and coordinate security specialists, security guards and auxiliary personnel. Manage workforce planning, schedules, shift coverage, substitutions and team allocation to ensure service continuity and operational efficiency.
* **Budget & Provider Management:** Prepare and monitor the annual security budget, optimising costs without compromising protection. Act as the main point of contact for external security providers, overseeing service levels, performance, contractual requirements and continuous improvement initiatives.
* **Physical & Electronic Security:** Ensure that warehouses, operational hubs and other facilities meet InPost's minimum security standards. Oversee the design, implementation, commissioning and maintenance of CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, alarm and intercom systems, ensuring reliability, interoperability and availability across all sites.
* **Security Systems Administration:** Administer security platforms across the network, including user permissions, access rights, system audits and periodic health checks. Apply basic IP networking knowledge to support connectivity between sites and security devices.
* **Governance & Compliance:** Ensure compliance with applicable Spanish, Portuguese and EU legislation, corporate security policies and relevant international standards, including TAPA and ISO. Develop and implement security procedures, policies and projects across the assigned territory.
* **Audits & Continuous Improvement:** Plan and conduct security audits across facilities, identify gaps, implement corrective action plans and monitor progress. Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to incident reduction, audit compliance, service quality and system availability.
* **Incident & Crisis Management:** Lead incident reporting, assessment, investigation and resolution, coordinating root cause analysis and corrective actions. Manage critical security incidents, coordinate investigations and ensure timely communication with relevant stakeholders. Act as a 24/7 security point of contact for the assigned network.

Job Description:

We are seeking a forward-thinking security leader to become our AI CISO. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI security at a global scale, protecting our models, data, and infrastructure from emerging threats while fostering responsible and ethical AI innovation.

**About the job**

**Job purpose**

Your purpose is to build and run a holistic AI security program for AXA. You will establish the governance, risk management framework, and security controls to protect our AI/ML models and data, ensuring that AXA's use of AI is not only powerful but also secure and trustworthy.

**Main missions**

Your mission is to build the program around the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, adapted for AI:

* Govern: Develop and follow implementation the Group's AI Security Strategy, in line with responsible AI principles and emerging regulations (e.g., EU AI Act). Establish policies for secure AI development, data usage, and model governance
* Identify: Lead risk assessments methodology design on AI models and systems, focusing on unique threats like data poisoning, model evasion, adversarial attacks, and prompt injection. Ensure a consolidate inventory of critical AI assets
* Protect: Define security standards and architecture patterns for the AI/ML lifecycle, from secure data acquisition and feature engineering to model training and deployment. Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of models and training data
* Detect: Oversee the implementation of monitoring mechanisms to detect model drift, anomalous behavior, and security attacks against AI systems. Define AI-specific incident precursors for the SOC
* Respond & Recover: Define and test the incident response playbook for AI-specific security events, such as a compromised model or a severe data leak through a Generative AI service

**Expected skills & experience**

We are looking for someone with the following experience and skills:

**Experience**

More than 10 years of experience in Information Security or a related field, with demonstrated experience in a leadership role focused on data science, AI/ML, or the security thereof.

**Technical skills**

* Good understanding of the AI/ML lifecycle
* Knowledge of common AI frameworks
* Familiarity with AI-specific security threats (adversarial ML, etc.) and controls
* Knowledge of data privacy and emerging AI regulations is essential

**Soft skills / transversal skills**

Profile

* Fluent in English. Outstanding oral and written communication skills with proven ability to develop and present concise information
* Strong multi-cultural understanding
* Experience of interacting with Directors and all levels of management
* Team player and able to collaborate, influence and guide others

Strategic Mindset

* A passion for innovation balanced with a pragmatic, risk-based approach. Ability to think strategically and establish a new function in a complex, global organization
* Maintains a wider perspective, aligns actions and contributes to the enhancement of the overall organizational strategy, including outputs from benchmarking activities and reviews
* Understands and articulates the projected direction of the organization and how changes to it might impact the group
* Is aware of trends in the external environment and key differentiators vis-à-vis competition and uses this information to anticipate how these changes would impact the organization

Leadership / Stakeholder Management / Communication:

* A visionary leader capable of navigating ambiguity and influencing a wide range of stakeholders to adopt new security paradigms in a matrix organization
* Ability to build consensus and drive collaboration between highly technical data science teams, business units, AXA Group functions, and AXA entities.
* Exceptional ability to communicate in English, translating complex AI security concepts into clear, actionable guidance for diverse audiences from developers to senior executives

**Where will you be in the organization?**

**The department / team**

* The division: As the thematic CISO for Artificial Intelligence within Group Security, you will be AXA's leading expert on AI security. You will partner with data science teams, innovation hubs, and local CISOs to ensure our AI initiatives are secure, trustworthy, and compliant.

  

* The department / team: Operating within a global matrix structure, you will use your leadership and influence to embed security into the entire AI lifecycle across all AXA entities. Your mission is to make "secure AI" a core principle of every project, ensuring our innovation is built on a foundation of trust.

We bring together the expertise, cultural diversity and creativity of over 8,000 employees worldwide and we’re committed to equal opportunities in all aspects of employment (gender, LGBT+, disabled persons, or people of different origins) and to promoting Diversity & Inclusion by creating a work environment where all employees are treated with dignity and respect, and where individual differences are valued.

title: European Logistics Operations Manager
description:
Trek Travel provides global cycling, hiking, and walking vacations of a lifetime with the goal of helping more people actively explore and experience the world. We are looking to hire a European Logistics Operations Manager to plan and manage operations, lead the European Logistics team, and collaborate across the company to deliver an awesome guest experience at our Girona Warehouse, The ROW Logistics.  
  
The European Logistics Operations Manager must possess a wide variety of skills, including excellent organization, a drive for continuous improvement, and the ability to analyze and interpret multiple data points to plan current operations and forecast future operations and budget cycles. They will have experience managing, coaching, and motivating teams to deliver awesome hospitality and uphold high standards. This is your opportunity to join The ROW Logistics/Trek Travel team and leave your mark on our company, on the active travel industry and on the world at large.  
  
**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE, BUT NOT LIMITED TO:**  
**Unit & Fleet Operations**

* Coordinate, communicate, and oversee Unit Operations in Europe, including Fleet Lifecycle, Bike Allocation, Field Support, and Unit Equipment & Inventory.
* Manage Unit condition throughout the season, analyzing trends to forecast and plan efficient, cost-effective distribution and maintenance of bikes and equipment.
* Collaborate with the European Schedule Coordinator to ensure an efficient, cost-effective schedule for unit movement.
* Set and communicate standards for Unit Work, Load/Unload, and Unit handoffs; ensure reports are completed and follow up when standards are not met.
* Own the European fleet lifecycle: resource planning for new fleet builds, end-of-season service, retirement and resale of the outgoing fleet, and international shipments, including customs documentation.
* Oversee and maintain accurate data on bike assets and inventory in our systems, and implement tracking and controls for bikes, batteries, navigation devices, and other high-value equipment.

**Budget, Bike Sales & Facilities**

* Manage the European Logistics budget, including current and future year forecasting, controlling spend on parts, shipping, consumables, and facilities, and proactively identifying cost-reduction opportunities.
* Own European Bike Sales results: work with the Bike Sales Coordinator to set and implement sales strategy, pricing, and targets, with direction from the Director of Logistics and Finance, and report on results.
* Manage the Girona warehouse facility, including leases, utilities, licenses and permits, maintenance, safety, and security, in collaboration with Finance.
* Partner with Finance, legal counsel, and corporate service providers on Spanish entity compliance, contracts, and vendor agreements.
* Deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting to the Director of Logistics and the Leadership team.
* Support the Logistics team with special projects and continuous improvement efforts.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Sales & Guest Experience: own timely resolution of logistics-related Log Letters and drive root-cause fixes, answer questions, and build excellent working relationships with the team.
* Trip Design: complete initial trip logistics reviews as assigned, provide Ground Operations oversight, participate in End of Season meetings, and act as a resource to support Trip Design activities.
* Guide Department: provide field support; own and uphold Logistics standards for guides (unit handoffs, load/unload, unit work, equipment use, etc.); and partner with the Guide Manager on accountability when standards are not met.
* Contribute to global Logistics and The ROW Logistics/Trek Travel with awesome communication and collaboration

**Team Management**

* Lead the European Logistics team by training, coaching, and deeply understanding operational needs. Hold people accountable and coach for growth, or for change when needed, to maintain a high-performing Logistics team.
* Oversee the Fleet Operations Coordinator to ensure accurate forecasting and budgeting, compliance with service and maintenance, tracking and leasing documentation, vehicle availability, and damage/repair follow-up.
* Oversee the Equipment & Inventory Coordinator to ensure Units are stocked appropriately, equipment is maintained, reporting is complete, and parts and consumables requests follow standards.
* Oversee the Bike Mechanics to deliver bike builds, service, and maintenance to Trek Travel standards.
* Oversee the Bike Sales Coordinator to deliver bike sales results and an organized, efficient warehouse.
* Track staff performance and conduct ongoing continuous improvement feedback and performance evaluations.
* Monitor and communicate individual hours submissions, workload, and time off approvals.
* Manage onboarding and training of new teammates, plus in-year training as needed.
* Create a Great Place to Work, foster the company culture, and contribute to a fun, inclusive, safe, and healthy work environment.

**WHAT ELSE WE'D LIKE TO SEE FROM YOU:**

* A minimum of 3 years of experience managing operations, logistics, or an equivalent role.
* A minimum of 3 years of experience managing one or more direct reports.
* EU work authorization and a valid driver’s license.
* A technical cycling background with an understanding of SRAM and Shimano bike mechanics.
* Experience managing budgets and controlling operating costs, including negotiating with vendors or landlords.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to manage multi-disciplinary projects and navigate complex challenges within tight time constraints.
* Proficiency in Microsoft applications and an understanding of, or ability to learn, Power BI, Power Apps, and other project management tools. Comfortable working in inventory, ERP, and booking systems.
* Ability to set clear standards and hold others to them, including peers and partners outside your direct line, with diplomacy and consistency.
* Confidence in your problem-solving abilities and the ability to exercise great judgment with timely decision-making.
* Strong team management skills and the ability to delegate tasks to others as necessary.
* High attention to detail and efficiency, and you work with a sense of urgency.
* You take initiative to continuously improve processes and are solution-oriented.
* Spanish language skills are a plus.
* You believe in the importance of hospitality and customer service, recognizing that customers are all around.
* You rock a positive, solution-oriented attitude and always ask “how can I help?”
* You exude fun and flexibility while contributing to the overall success of your Team.

**TREK TRAVEL OFFERS:**

* A fast pace, casual, fun, and flexible company culture where initiative and pro-activity are highly valued
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* Reward program for sustainable commuting to the office
* Employee discounts and outdoor industry discounts
* ...And More!

At The ROW Logistics/Trek Travel, we think outside the box, continuously improve, encourage feedback, and give it all we got, all the time, no exceptions. This is a full-time position and is based in Girona, Spain, requires a minimum of 4 days per week onsite, and reports to the Director of Logistics. Interest in the active travel industry is beneficial but not required.

title: Performance Creativities Coordinator
description:
#### **Tu misión**

Convertir la estrategia de testing del Creative Strategist / Head of Growth en un flujo constante y fiable de assets publicados. Es la responsable última de que los assets llegan a tiempo, con las especificaciones correctas y en el volumen necesario para alimentar el calendario de testing semanal: no coordina la producción, la lidera y la entrega. Su misión es que estrategia y ejecución avancen juntas, trabajando estrechamente con el Creative Strategist en prioridades, sourcing, briefing y entrega, garantizando que el canal nunca se queda sin contenido para testear.

#### **Tu perfil**

Dentro de sus responsabilidades, el/la Performance Creativities Coordinator será responsable de

**Ejecución y entrega de assets**

* Traduce las prioridades de testing del Creative Strategist en briefs concretos y ejecutables (concepto × acabado × formato)
* Hace seguimiento del estado de cada asset desde el brief hasta la entrega y alerta de retrasos con antelación suficiente
* Mantiene la biblioteca de assets organizada por canal y formato, con naming convention que permita rastrear rendimiento y reutilizar material
* Garantiza que cada asset cumple las especificaciones técnicas por canal: Meta, TikTok, AmazoN

**UGC y producción con creadores/as**

* Busca, briefea y gestiona el pool de creadoras UGC
* Es la propietaria de la cadencia de entrega y los derechos de uso del contenido de creadoras
* Coordina con agencias externas la ejecución y entrega de briefs
* Mantiene un ritmo de entrega semanal constante alineado con el calendario de testing del Creative Strategist

**Relaciones clave**

* Creative Strategist / Head of Growth: calendario de testing, prioridades y briefs — es su interlocutor/a principal
* Creadoras UGC y talent: sourcing, briefing y gestión de la relación
* UGC marketplaces: sourcing de nuevas creadoras
* Media Buyer: coordinación de go-live y publicación de anuncios
* Equipo de diseño (vídeo y estático): dirección de arte y capacidad de producción
* Creative Manager: coordinación de la producción creativa con el equipo de diseño

**KPIS de medición del rol:**

* Assets entregados en spec y en plazo
* Volumen de assets producidos por mes, desglosado por formato y canal
* Cumplimiento de la cadencia de entrega semanal
* Velocidad de testing creativo (compartido con Creative Strategist)

**Perfil orientado y requerimientos:**

**Experiencia y background:**

* 2-4 años en producción de contenido, coordinación creativa o UGC en entornos DTC o performance marketing
* Experiencia gestionando creadores/as con capacidad demostrada de obtener resultados positivos en las colaboraciones
* Haber trabajado en producción de alto volumen y alta cadencia, no en proyectos puntuales o hero assets
* Comprensión básica de paid social y qué métricas validan un concepto en Meta, TikTok y Amazon
* Muy valorable: experiencia trabajando codo a codo con un equipo de paid social o growth donde el contenido se mide por resultados
* Muy valorable: experiencia en health, beauty, wellness o alimentación

**Conocimientos clave:**  

* Criterio creativo propio: sabe cuándo una toma no vale, da feedback concreto y pide repetición
* Mentalidad de escala: optimiza para rango y velocidad, sabe cuándo algo es suficientemente bueno para testear
* Comodidad con sistemas estructurados: naming conventions, tracking de assets por concepto y volumen contra objetivo semanal
* Rigor absoluto en claims: ante la duda, se pregunta, no se publica
* Coordinación transversal con equipos que no le reportan, sin perder velocidad de entrega
* Don de gentes para construir relaciones de confianza con creadores/as
* Organización y fiabilidad: el equipo puede contar con ella para que lo prometido llega cuando estaba prometido
* Mejora continua: busca activamente cómo producir más con los mismos recursos sin perder calidad

#### **¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?**

* Unirte a una compañía con propósito real: alimentación saludable e innovación
* Salario acorde con *mercado* según know-how
* Cultura de colaboración, aprendizaje y confianza
* Posibilidad clara de crecimiento con el proyecto
* Modelo de trabajo híbrido (4p+1tt)
* Retribución flexible con nuestro partner Cobe*e*
* Descuentos top en todos los productos de Baïa
* Programa Baïa Benefits enfocados en tu bienestar físico y mental (te detallamos más adelante)

#### **¿Quiénes somos?**

En **Baïa Food** tenemos claro que con nuestro trabajo, cada día contribuimos a un gran propósito: **Acompañar a las personas en su camino hacia el bienestar para que puedan disfrutar de una vida más plena**. Pero, ¿Cómo lo hacemos? A través del desarrollo de **suplementos alimenticios innovadores basados en evidencia científica** y buen sabor, **sin azúcares ni edulcorantes.**

description:

**FX Senior Product Manager - Hedging conversion**

**Ebury Madrid Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week**

As Ebury scales globally, we are evolving from a delivery-led organisation into a **platform-led product** company - building shared foundations that allow teams to move faster, operate safely in regulated environments and deliver high-quality client experiences across channel

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to own one number: the share of Ebury's clients who convert into hedgers — and to build the journeys, workflows and decision tools that get them there.

Ebury has a real hedging business. Thousands of clients already hedge with us, they're our most valuable and stickiest, and Hedge works. The problem isn't proof of concept — it's rate. For every client who converts, several more carry the same currency exposure, would benefit from the same forward, and never get there.

Here's the honest reason why. Hedging isn't a product you sell; it's a conclusion a client reaches once they can see what their international business is actually exposed to. Today that seeing happens in a CPM's head and a spreadsheet, one client at a time. The client can't see their own exposure clearly, the CPM can't see it at scale, and so the conversation that should be obvious either happens late or never happens at all.

This role builds the layer that changes that: guided journeys and lifecycle workflows that carry a client from unaware exposure to a first hedge to a standing policy — and the decision tools that let both the client and their CPM understand the client's international business well enough to make the right call, not just the next call.

You'll sit at the intersection of product, data, and commercial, working closely with:

* CPMs and Sales teams who convert clients today
* Data and Analytics
* Design and Engineering
* Compliance and Risk
* Clients directly

**What you'll do**

You will own the end-to-end conversion journey into hedging, backed by a dedicated squad of developers, including:

**Journeys & Lifecycle Workflows**

* The path from spot client Hedge-active policy client, and every drop-off point along it
* Guided, staged journeys rather than one-off prompts: the right message, to the right client, at the moment their exposure is real to them
* Triggered workflows off real events, a new currency pair, a large invoice, a rate move against them, a forward maturing
* Understanding what separates the clients who convert from the ones who don't, and building for the difference

**Decision Tools for Clients**

* Showing a client what their international business is actually exposed to, in their own numbers and their own currencies
* Exposure views, scenario and impact modelling, MTM and forward comparisons a finance lead can act on without training
* Turning "should I hedge?" into a question the client can answer for themselves, with confidence
* Balancing honesty about risk against simplicity of decision, the goal is a well-made decision, not a sold one

**Tooling for CPMs**

* Giving CPMs a portfolio-level view of client exposure, trades and performance, so they know who to talk to and what to say before the client asks
* Surfacing the signals that make a conversation timely: unhedged exposure, changing trade patterns, policy lapses
* Learning from the conversations that already convert clients, and productising them

**Repeat Hedging & Policy**

* Turning a first hedge into a second and a third
* Moving clients from ad-hoc trades onto a standing hedging policy they run every month
* Statements, notifications and review moments that build the habit and prove the value after the fact

**Experimentation & Measurement**

* A cadence of A/B tests across the journey, not a feature backlog
* Reading results honestly, including the ones that kill your own ideas
* Building the measurement so conversion, and what's driving it

**What success looks like (12-18 months)**

* Spot-to-hedger conversion rate is measurably higher, and you can attribute the lift
* A meaningful share of new hedgers convert through product journeys rather than a CPM conversation
* CPMs work from exposure signals in a tool instead of instinct and spreadsheets, and cover more clients as a result
* Clients can articulate their own FX exposure — and clients who hedge once come back without being called
* More hedgers move onto hedging policies rather than trading ad hoc
* Product — not people — becomes the primary driver of hedging conversion

**What makes this role hard**

* You're changing behaviour, not shipping features. The instrument already exists and works; the reason more clients don't use it is understanding, trust and habit.
* It's a two-sided problem. Clients and CPMs need different views of the same truth, and building for one badly makes the other worse but the CPMs must know what the client can see to have consultative conversations
* The baseline isn't zero. There's an existing business and an existing way of converting clients, you have to improve on it without disrupting it.
* Exposure is genuinely hard to model. Client data is incomplete, trade history is a proxy for intent, and being confidently wrong about someone's exposure destroys trust instantly.
* You're helping non-experts make decisions with real financial consequences. Oversimplify and you mislead; don't simplify and nobody acts.
* You'll navigate real-world complexity: regional and regulatory nuance, credit and margin implications, and client segments with genuinely different needs.

**Who we are looking for**

Prior FX or hedging experience is a plus, not a requirement. We're looking for someone who can move a hard conversion number in a complex, regulated environment — with strong agency, sharp analytical instincts, and a real feel for why people do and don't act.

**Must-have:**

* 4+ years of product management experience, including at least one role owning conversion, adoption or engagement outcomes end-to-end
* Strong analytics and experimentation skills — funnel analysis, cohort and retention analysis, designing and interpreting A/B tests
* Experience designing lifecycle journeys or triggered workflows, and the messaging that carries them
* Fluent English (daily collaboration with global commercial, tech and Legal/Compliance/Risk stakeholders)

**Nice-to-have:**

* Familiarity with foreign exchange, hedging or other asset classes
* Experience in fintech or regulated financial products
* Experience building internal or advisor-facing tooling alongside client-facing product
* Localisation awareness

**Core Capabilities**

* **Strong Product Fundamentals** — breaks down ambiguous problems into clear product opportunities; comfortable working across UX, data and operations; focused on outcomes, not just delivery.
* **Funnel & Journey Thinking** — instinctively looks for where clients fall out and why; designs staged journeys rather than isolated features; sizes the opportunity before designing the fix.
* **Two-Sided Design** — builds for clients and the internal teams serving them at once; understands the trade-offs between automation and human judgement.
* **Behavioural Instinct** — thinks in triggers, incentives and habit loops; understands that conversion is earned, not shipped.
* **Analytical Depth** — partners with Data rather than outsourcing the thinking; can build the exposure and funnel view themselves and defend it.
* **Commercial Awareness** — understands how product decisions land in revenue and margin; prioritises on business impact, not just user feedback.
* **High Agency & Pragmatism** — comfortable operating in under-defined environments; bias to action; doesn't wait for perfect structure.
* **Deep Customer Curiosity** — regularly speaks to clients and CPMs; uses it to inform decisions, not just validate them.

description:
You will join the studio as the manager of our technical team working on a live grand strategy game, together with the designers, artists and QA who build and test it. We are looking for a Managing Tech Lead to lead the team and keep the existing codebase healthy: maintaining it, improving it and making sure it keeps supporting the game as it grows.

We care about how the team works: clear technical goals, honest conversations about priorities, and people who grow. If you enjoy helping engineers do their best work, and still want to stay close enough to the craft to make good calls, this is a good place for that.

Here the leads plan, decide and build. Judgment and hands-on work go together. Stay close to the code, develop your leadership skills and make great games.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Manage the programming team: one-to-ones, feedback, career development, performance, hiring and onboarding.
* Set clear technical objectives for the team that support the creative vision and the product roadmap, and contribute to technical direction alongside the other leads.
* Drive improvements to the game and the existing codebase, with a focus on performance, stability and maintainability.
* Work with the other managers to remove blockers, keep production moving and balance technical decisions against scope, schedule and budget.
* Keep the team's work aligned with the roadmap across concurrent update branches, so that we build and release with as few technical setbacks as possible.
* Stay connected to Paradox's wider technical organization, so that practices, tools and knowledge flow in both directions.
* Time permitting, contribute hands-on: implementing features and systems, reviewing code and solving gameplay problems with efficient technical solutions.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Solid C++ experience in a professional setting, ideally in games, including at least one shipped or live title.
* Experience leading a team of programmers, including the people side: setting expectations, giving feedback, and having the difficult conversations.
* Technical judgment: you prioritize under real constraints, make trade-offs and own the call.
* The ability to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and non-engineers alike.
* A history of improving how a team works. There is a practice, tool or workflow that exists, or was killed, because of you.
* Clear, direct communication in English, written and spoken.

**Things to elevate your application**
--------------------------------------

* Paradox grand strategy experience, Europa Universalis especially. Genuine interest in the genre matters more than logged hours.
* Experience on a live title with a recurring update cadence.
* Experience working with a large, long-lived codebase.

**The Studio**
--------------

Paradox Tinto was founded in 2020 by a small and dedicated team of industry veterans led by Johan Andersson, and building on our experience from Paradox Interactive and Paradox Development Studio, we develop Europa Universalis V, the latest entry in the grand strategy franchise that started it all more than twenty-five years ago.

**The Team**
------------

At Paradox Tinto we work in a small, gameplay focused team, where everyone is part of crafting the player experience and has input on the design of the game. We believe game development should be fun, and we strive for a relaxed, stress-free atmosphere. Being a small studio built from the ground up, we expect everyone to contribute to the development of the studio and its culture. We are also proud of having accessible, experienced managers who lead you and care about you. Your contributions matter to us, to the whole studio, and to the games we make. You will be close to the final product, our community and our fans. We will encourage you to interact with our players directly through social media, our forum, and via streams. Work/life balance matters to us, so our development plans do not rely on crunch. This does not mean we never work overtime, but overtime is relatively uncommon and not encouraged.

**The Location**
----------------

Our office is 300m from one of the beaches of Sitges, a picturesque Mediterranean coastal city. It is well connected by public transport and within walking distance of restaurants, bars, pharmacies, supermarkets, shops and hotels. Sitges is barely 20 minutes by car or bus from El Prat, Barcelona's international airport. It offers 17 beaches along its own coastline, the Costa del Garraf, and an average of 300 days of sun a year, which is hard to argue with for outdoor sports and weekends. Mountain lovers still have the Pyrenees, only a two hour drive away. The town will also captivate you with its cultural events, Mediterranean food and, of course, excellent Spanish wine.

**Some of our benefits**
------------------------

* 25 working days of vacation per year (23 per the collective agreement, plus 2 extra)
* Private health insurance
* Wellhub subscription: gym access and digital wellbeing apps
* A private gym at the office, plus optional free yoga and HIIT sessions
* Cobee by Pluxee flexible compensation, letting you allocate part of your gross salary to meals or public transport
* Free access to the full Paradox catalogue on Steam, over 100 games
* Healthy snacks and soft drinks, a private garden, and regular team activities

If you think this description matches you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we interview candidates continuously. If you don't match all the requirements, tell us how your passion, attitude and interest in Paradox might compensate.

At Paradox Interactive we celebrate difference and care deeply about diversity and inclusion. We therefore encourage you, no matter who you are, to apply for this job if you think you'd be a great addition to our team.

-------------------------

Scope: Full-time and permanent

Location: Sitges, Barcelona (Spain)

WFH/WFO: 100% onsite

title: Director, EMEA Regional Marketing
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

Talkdesk is seeking a strategic, commercially minded **Director of EMEA Regional Marketing** to lead regional marketing strategy, execution, and business impact across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

This leader will serve as a key strategic partner to EMEA sales leadership, translating regional business priorities, market opportunities, and customer insights into integrated marketing strategies that build awareness, create demand, deepen account engagement, and accelerate pipeline.

As part of the global Growth Marketing organization, the Director will connect global marketing strategy with regional market needs, orchestrating campaigns, account-based marketing (ABM), digital, partner, customer, and experiential programs to deliver measurable business outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with operational excellence, brings a strong understanding of enterprise B2B marketing, and thrives in a matrixed, cross-functional environment. This individual will be equally comfortable advising regional sales leadership, developing market-specific growth plans, and leading teams to deliver high-impact marketing programs.

**Success in this role will be measured not by the volume of marketing activities delivered, but by their contribution to regional growth, account engagement, pipeline development, and revenue outcomes.**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Regional Strategy & Business Alignment**

* Own the development and execution of an integrated EMEA regional marketing strategy aligned to global marketing priorities, regional business objectives, and revenue goals.
* Serve as a strategic marketing partner to EMEA sales leadership, developing a deep understanding of regional priorities, market dynamics, customer segments, and growth opportunities.
* Translate business objectives into actionable regional marketing plans that support market development, demand creation, pipeline generation, and deal acceleration.
* Identify and prioritize marketing investments across EMEA markets based on business potential, account opportunity, sales capacity, and expected impact.
* Bring regional market intelligence, customer insights, and competitive perspectives into global marketing planning and investment decisions.

### **Integrated Demand Generation & Account Engagement**

* Lead the regional activation of integrated marketing programs across digital, ABM, content, partner, customer, and experiential channels.
* Partner with global Campaigns, ABM, Digital, and Marketing Operations teams to translate global programs into relevant, high-impact regional initiatives.
* Develop targeted engagement strategies for priority industries, strategic accounts, and high-value opportunities in partnership with sales and account teams.
* Drive marketing programs across the customer journey, from awareness and demand creation to opportunity progression, pipeline acceleration, and customer expansion.
* Ensure regional marketing activities deliver coordinated, meaningful engagement with buying groups and key decision-makers.
* Evaluate and deploy the most effective mix of marketing channels, programs, and experiences to achieve defined business outcomes.

### **Sales, Partner & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Establish strong, trusted relationships with regional sales leaders, account executives, business development teams, and other go-to-market stakeholders.
* Lead collaborative planning with sales to establish shared priorities, target accounts, engagement strategies, and measurable success criteria.
* Partner with global marketing functions, including Campaigns, ABM, Digital, Product Marketing, Corporate Marketing, and Marketing Operations, to ensure alignment and maximize the impact of regional investments.
* Collaborate with partner and alliance marketing stakeholders to integrate ecosystem opportunities into regional growth plans, including co-marketing and joint demand-generation initiatives.
* Facilitate clear communication, accountability, and coordination across regional and global teams to deliver a cohesive go-to-market experience.

### **Performance, Investment & Optimization**

* Own regional marketing planning, budget management, investment prioritization, and performance optimization.
* Establish clear KPIs and measurement frameworks aligned to regional business objectives, including account engagement, pipeline creation, pipeline influence, opportunity progression, and marketing ROI.
* Leverage CRM, marketing automation, intent, engagement, and performance data to identify opportunities, optimize investments, and improve program effectiveness.
* Provide regular, actionable insights to regional sales and global marketing leadership, connecting marketing performance to business outcomes.
* Continuously evaluate marketing investments, reallocating resources toward the programs, channels, and markets delivering the greatest impact.

### **Team Leadership & Operational Excellence**

* Lead, coach, and develop regional marketing talent, fostering a culture of strategic thinking, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Establish clear roles, priorities, operating rhythms, and performance expectations for the regional marketing team.
* Build scalable, repeatable processes that improve marketing effectiveness while allowing for necessary regional and market-level flexibility.
* Champion a business-first, outcome-oriented marketing mindset that prioritizes strategic impact over activity volume.
* Navigate a matrixed global organization effectively, influencing cross-functional stakeholders and driving alignment without relying solely on direct reporting relationships.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required Experience & Skills**

* 8–10+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including significant experience in regional marketing, integrated demand generation, account-based marketing, or related growth marketing disciplines.
* Demonstrated success developing and executing regional marketing strategies that contribute to pipeline creation, opportunity acceleration, and revenue growth.
* Strong understanding of enterprise B2B go-to-market models, complex buying journeys, and multi-stakeholder account engagement.
* Experience partnering directly with senior sales leadership to develop joint business plans, align priorities, and drive measurable outcomes.
* Proven ability to orchestrate integrated marketing programs across multiple channels and global marketing functions.
* Experience working across EMEA markets, with an appreciation for regional differences, customer behaviors, market maturity, and local go-to-market requirements.
* Strong analytical and commercial acumen, with the ability to translate marketing and sales data into actionable investment decisions.
* Experience managing marketing budgets, prioritizing resources, and demonstrating return on marketing investment.
* Demonstrated leadership experience, including developing talent, managing teams, and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, executive presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
* Working knowledge of CRM, marketing automation, ABM, and marketing performance technologies.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in enterprise SaaS, cloud technology, customer experience, or contact center technology.
* Experience supporting multiple EMEA subregions and coordinating marketing efforts across diverse markets.
* Familiarity with partner-led and ecosystem-based go-to-market strategies.
* Experience operating within a centralized global marketing organization and matrixed regional sales structure.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Willingness to travel within EMEA and internationally as business needs require.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

The Director, EMEA Regional Marketing will establish marketing as a proactive, strategic growth partner to the regional business.

Success will be demonstrated through:

* **Strategic alignment:** Clear, prioritized regional marketing plans jointly developed with sales and connected to global growth priorities.
* **Meaningful account engagement:** Increased reach, engagement, and buying-group penetration across strategic accounts and priority market segments.
* **Pipeline contribution:** Measurable marketing impact on pipeline creation, opportunity progression, and revenue outcomes.
* **Integrated execution:** Effective activation of global marketing programs through coordinated regional, account, digital, partner, and customer engagement strategies.
* **Investment effectiveness:** Data-driven allocation of resources toward high-impact programs and measurable business returns.
* **Organizational leadership:** A high-performing regional marketing team recognized for commercial acumen, proactive collaboration, and accountability.

**This role is an opportunity to shape how regional marketing contributes to enterprise growth—moving beyond tactical execution to become a strategic driver of market opportunity, customer engagement, and revenue performance.**
