title: 2026 Managing Director
description:
**Who we are:**

United We Dream (UWD) is the largest immigrant youth-led community in the country. We create welcoming spaces for young people – regardless of immigration status – to support, engage, and empower them to make their voices heard and win!

With an online reach of over 5 million every month, more than 1,000,000 members as well as 4 statewide branches and local groups across 28 states. UWD is made up of fearless young people fighting to improve the lives of our members and their families. Our vision is a society which celebrates our diversity and believes in a multi-ethnic, intersectional path to getting there. Over 60% of our members are womxn and 30% identify as LGBTQ.

We are driven by the priorities and needs of our members; have trained thousands of individuals; and have supported countless local organizing groups. Our grassroots-driven approach has a proven record of success and we’re looking for talented folks to join our team!

Learn more about United We Dream by visiting www.unitedwedream.org.

**Position Summary**

United We Dream is seeking a new senior leader and organization-builder to serve in the role of Managing Director. In partnership with the Executive Director, the Managing Director will develop and drive an organizational strategy to maximize UWD’s assets including its people power, brand, as well as financial and operational resources, to build the power necessary to change the lives of our members, leaders and communities.

We are looking for an experienced, strategic, insightful, and mission-driven leader who thrives on creating and managing systems and community in service to an organization’s mission. As the primary thought partner to the Executive Director (ED), the Managing Director translates the organization’s vision into seamless, cohesive execution across five core pillars: 1) long-term organizational strategic vision; 2) financial sustainability & growth strategy; 3) operations strategy responsive to the needs of a fast-paced community power building infrastructure; 4) organizational security and compliance strategy; and 5) organizational structure and culture that successfully drives organizational priorities.

This position works with all members of the internal leadership, including leading the Executive Team and the Senior Leadership Team, and will coordinate internal processes across departments to cultivate and maintain an effective team, a commitment to excellence, and healthy organizational culture.

A successful candidate will be passionate about UWD’s mission and be highly motivated to work in a fast-growing, front-line, history-making organization. They must be committed to leadership development, power building, and building collaborative structures which make the most of a highly talented staff team.

This is a full-time exempt position. Much day-to-day work will be handled remotely, but travel (local, nation-wide, international) is expected for approximately 30-40% of the time. Applicants working in the eastern time zone are preferred but not required. Multilingual communication skills are a plus though not required.

**Primary Responsibilities**

### **Long-Term Organizational Strategy & Leadership Alignment**

* Strategic Thought Partner: Serves as thought partner to the Executive Director on all aspects of organizational strategy including programs, internal operations and team management, growth, and brand.
* Strategic Planning: Lead the development, rollout, and regular evaluation of the multi-year organizational strategic vision in partnership with the Executive Director, Senior Leadership Team, and Board of Directors.
* Execution & Accountability: Lead the Executive Team, the Senior Leadership Team, and the Staff through annual goal setting, translating the organization’s long-term vision into ambitious but realizable organizational goals that build year after year
  + Works with the Senior Leadership Team to arrive at Department-Level goals that will implement the organizational goals
  + Leads periodic stepbacks with the SLT and the Staff to assess progress made on goals as well as any changes that need to be made
* Internal Leadership:

* Provides day-to-day management of the Executive Team and the Senior Leadership Team and ensures that the teams are high functioning, collaborative and effective leadership bodies.
  + Lead ET and SLT meetings and stepback spaces
* Oversees planning and execution of all-staff and all-leadership gatherings and retreats.
* Staffs the Executive Director in internal settings or speaks on their behalf in internal settings when required.
* Serves as the chief of internal communications, crafting and/or approving internal communications materials related to United We Dream’s organizational effectiveness.
* Supports the Executive Director to ensure the achievement of key internal culture and operations goals.
* Board Management:
  + Work with the Executive Director and Co-Chairs of the Board to lead board meetings and relevant board committee meetings
  + Prepare high-level briefings and strategic board materials
  + Facilitate alignment at Executive Committee meetings.
* Special Projects: Direct priority high-stakes or rapid-response projects and incubates initiatives from concept to handoff or implementation.

### **Financial Sustainability & Growth Strategy**

* Supervise the Senior Director of Finance and Development
* Revenue Strategy Collaboration: Partner with the Senior Director of Finance and Development to strategize around and execute long-term revenue diversification strategies, including major gifts, institutional funding, earn-income models, and rapid-response campaign fundraising.
* Resource Allocation: Partner with the Senior Director of Finance and Development to ensure strategic priorities are directly linked to annual budgeting and financial forecasting analysis, optimizing resource allocation for maximum programmatic impact.
* Capital & Reserve Management: Partner with the Senior Director of Finance and Development to oversee financial sustainability and growth metrics, long-term reserve and investments planning, and fiscal decision-making models to weather potential political or economic shifts.

### **Operational Strategy & Organizational Effectiveness**

* Supervise the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems.
* Oversee the contract relationship with our operations partner Seed the Dream, and create staff and consultant support systems as needed.
* Change Management:
  + Lead major organizational change initiatives or organizational redesigns
  + Partner with the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems to lead culture-building endeavors that promote courage, rigor, community, resilience, and high performance.
* Inter-Departmental Collaboration:
  + Serve as the central, high-level oversight ensuring effective coordination between all parts of the organization – the Membership and Campaigns Department, Narrative Department, Development Department, Finance Department, and the Data and Operations Department.
* Movement-Values Aligned & Effective Operations:
  + Oversees the Operations partner to ensure the complete, seamless, and values-aligned operational apparatus and set-up for programs, activities, tactics, etc.
  + Oversees the Operations partner to ensure the complete, seamless, and values-aligned planning and execution of in-person events or actions, including large scale ones with multiple external participants and partners.

### **Security, Risk Mitigation & Compliance**

* Holistic Organizational Strategy:
  + Anticipate and monitor changes in legal, regulatory and administrative environments
    - Partner with the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems to devise plans to implement changes in organizational policies/procedures as needed to maintain compliance.
    - Partner with the Adviser on Special Projects and the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems to strategize about legal risks to the organization and bring in necessary counsel
    - Partner with the Narrative Director to assess any additions to external communications strategy
  + Anticipate and monitor our organizational security needs across all aspects (physical, digital, data, reputational, etc.) and and partner with the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems to devise plans for improvements necessary to support the growth of specific programs and UWD overall;
* Legal Compliance: Ensure complete compliance across nonprofit regulatory frameworks (including 501(c)(3) / 501(c)(4) advocacy and lobbying rules, charitable registrations, etc.), maintaining proactive legal and reputational risk management policies and systems.
* Crisis Management: Develop and maintain rapid-response crisis plans, leading incident response teams during political retaliation, legal challenges, security breaches, or public relations crises.

**Organizational Leadership**

* Strengthen the culture: Partner with the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems to ensure a safe, welcoming, and inspiring organizational culture for staff to excel in. Role model and uphold UWD’s values of creating a courageous, rigorous, and community-oriented working environment.
  + Partner with the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems and with the Operations partner to develop, revise, and uphold organization policies and standards, ensuring that organizational policies are in line with the organization’s guiding principles as well as relevant compliance regulations and concerns.
* Support fundraising:Collaborate with the Executive Director and Development Department team in developing and executing a forward-thinking fundraising strategy for organizational priorities.
* Demonstrate embodied leadership:Prioritize taking care of your physical and emotional health as a key component of thriving in your role. Practice self-care behaviors in ways that work best for you and proactively encourage your staff to prioritize self-care as well. Project trust & confidence in your abilities and skills and recognize the achievements and abilities of others
* Manage organizational change:As the organization undergoes continued growth and innovation, the Managing Director will manage organizational change in a way that inspires and activates the Board, staff, members and community.

**Desired Qualifications and Skills**

* 8+ years of experience in the progressive, non-profit or movement space with a well rounded background across organizational departments.
* Well developed emotional intelligence and communication skills, is able to build trusting relationships with a wide array of individuals
* A critical thinker and a capable, flexible, curious generalist.
* Demonstrated experience in successfully developing and executing major, large-scale project plans involving many moving pieces and collaborators.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with an ability to understand a wide range of audiences and interests.
* Demonstrated experience in building staff teams, management, coaching and leadership development.
* The ability to build strong relationships internal to the organization and external for the organization
* Experience with seeing the long vision of an organization while understanding the importance of accomplishing short and medium term objectives.
* Experience with being able to conceptualize and approach problems and solutions in a proactive, constructive, and innovative manner that will result in improved performance across the organization.
* Strong follow through with principals and with organizers.
* A passion for the mission: We believe that those closest to the pain are the closest to the solutions, therefore a successful candidate must be “all in” on UWD being an immigrant youth-led organization

**Interpersonal Skills**

* An exceptional team player; exemplifies a work style that is committed to the excellence that our members and team deserve while being flexible, respectful, collaborative and nimble;
* Can build trust, confidence, and leadership among a diverse range of staff, fellow, partner organizations - across race, gender, and other identities

**Cultural Competency**

* Strong understanding of the immigrant experience, preferably with lived experience as an undocumented person, immigrant, or immigrant family
* Understanding of race, gender, sexuality and other aspects of identity, and their intersections, and how that plays out in the work. Experience building strong relationships and trust across race, gender, class, and other group identities, both internally and externally
* Brings an anti-racist lens to their work and understands the role that white-supremacy and anti-Blackness play in the environments in which we operate
* Demonstrates self-awareness of their own multiple group identities and their attendant dynamics, and can adapt the approach as needed
* Experience working in communities of color and/or building multiracial organizing efforts
* Knowledge of immigrants rights’ policy and organizing landscape is preferred

**Compensation**

Salary Range: $160,000.00- $180,000.00

**Benefits:**

  

* Employees who have completed less than 1 year of service with United We Dream:
  + 10 Vacation days per year
* Employees who have completed more than 1 year of service but less than 3 with United We Dream:
  + 12 Vacation days per year
* Employees who have completed more than 3 years of service but less than 5 with United We Dream:
  + 17 Vacation days per year
* Employees who have completed more than 5 years of service with United We Dream:
  + 22 Vacation days per year
* Paid two weeks Off Holiday between December and January.
* 12 Paid holidays
* 4% 403(B) employer discretionary contribution
* 12 weeks of paid family leave (after 1 and 1 day of service)
* Medical/Dental/Vision/Life coverage
* $120 Reimbursement included cell service/data and utilities monthly
* $500 Reimbursement for office supplies working from home annually
* $2000 Stipend towards professional development

**To Apply**

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled. Please submit a cover letter, resume, at least one writing example, and salary requirement via email to **humanresources@unitedwedream.org** and include **Managing Director (LAST NAME, FIRST NAME)** in the subject line. Please do not send duplicate materials and incomplete applications will not be considered. No phone calls, please.

###

UWD is an equal opportunity employer; people of color and individuals from diverse backgrounds are encouraged to apply. title: Marketing Director
description:
Excellent creative work can help extraordinary organizations raise more and serve more. Unseen is looking for a Marketing Director who knows what great looks like, can explain why it works, and can bring together the people who make it happen.

You will own Unseen's brand, voice, marketing strategy, and creative standard. You will lead an outside agency through a brand rebuild, turn that work into a focused annual marketing plan, and direct major projects for selected Unseen partners.

You will turn complex information into compelling ideas that capture attention, build belief, and motivate action. You will set creative direction and hold teams accountable for quality.

Creating amazing products and campaigns is the floor. Activating people to invest in anti trafficking work is the job.

About Unseen

Unseen accelerates the fight against human trafficking and its root causes. We equip anti-trafficking organizations around the world with marketing, fundraising, and storytelling tools, and we deliver strategic grants that fund their most critical projects.

Since 2011, Unseen has worked with 94 partner organizations in 66 countries. Those partners have raised more than $119 million and served more than 1.3 million people.

We are entering a new chapter and investing in the leadership and creative work to support it.

The opportunity

This is a role for someone whose strength is creative judgment and leadership. You can recognize an exceptional idea, write a clear brief, give specific feedback, and push work further. You know how to recruit talented people and hold them to a high standard.

You will have direct access to Unseen's leadership, room to challenge assumptions, and the opportunity to shape work with lasting consequences. We want someone who can push back on the CEO's preferences, support their recommendations, and earn trust through their decisions.

You will lead through strategy, direction, and accountability, not by personally producing every asset. A social media specialist will activate the social strategy, and a production manager and production team will manage the execution of creative projects. You will guide the standard of work, help identify outside talent, and collaborate with the people responsible for daily delivery.

What you will lead

Brand and voice. Serve as the primary day-to-day client for an outside brand agency, guide the rebuild, and establish standards the team can consistently apply.

Marketing strategy. Build and execute an annual plan with clear audiences, priorities, budgets, responsibilities, and measures of success. Define how marketing builds awareness and trust, motivates engagement, and supports measurable growth.

Visibility and credibility. Build Unseen's visibility and credibility among priority donors and businesses, activating established relationships and advocates in selected markets.

Fundraising communications. Set the strategy and creative direction for campaigns, stories, and materials that support philanthropic strategy, major gifts, Guardian Business expansion, and a major capital initiative.

Partner projects. Lead strategic and creative oversight for substantial marketing and storytelling assignments for selected Unseen partners, with scope and delivery commitments established through the annual plan.

Creative talent. Identify, evaluate, recruit, and brief excellent agencies, freelancers, and other creative specialists.

Quality and accountability. Set creative standards, provide decisive feedback, and remain accountable for the quality and strategic effectiveness of work delivered by staff, production teams, agencies, and contractors without directly managing every task.

Practical AI adoption. Champion thoughtful AI use in research, creative development, workflows, and production, while protecting accuracy, privacy, and storytelling integrity.

Our philanthropic leadership owns fundraising strategy, donor relationships, and asks. Our Guardian Business lead owns that program's expansion. You will be their marketing partner, responsible for work that helps them succeed.

What you bring

* Exceptional creative judgment across storytelling, copy, design, photography, video, and campaigns.
* Demonstrated ability to turn complex information into persuasive creative concepts using audience psychology, narrative tension, message hierarchy, and clear calls to action.
* A track record of developing campaigns that produce measurable results, including fundraising outcomes, with an honest account of your strategy, decisions, contribution, and results.
* Experience selecting, briefing, directing, and evaluating outside agencies and creative specialists, including providing clear feedback and knowing when to change course.
* The ability to recruit strong creative talent beyond your existing contacts.
* Clear, constructive leadership that makes other people's work better.
* Strong execution skills, including setting priorities, managing budgets, and delivering on commitments through teams.
* Resourcefulness within a limited budget, with the judgment to surface tradeoffs early and recommend solutions.
* Practical fluency with AI tools and the ability to lead adoption collaboratively.
* Respect for ethical, survivor-centered storytelling that protects dignity, informed consent, privacy, and personal agency.

An established network of creative professionals, agencies, media contacts, or business partners is a plus. Experience in anti-trafficking work is welcome but not required.

What success looks like

In your first year, you will:

* Launch Unseen's brand rebuild and establish a consistent voice and creative standard.
* Build and execute a focused annual marketing plan with defined audiences, engagement goals, and performance measures.
* Provide creative direction and quality oversight for priority campaigns and partner projects delivered by the responsible teams against agreed goals, schedules, and budgets.
* Equip our fundraising and Guardian Business teams with compelling, useful materials and evaluate how those materials support engagement and growth.
* Build a dependable bench of creative specialists and strong working relationships with production leadership.
* Improve how we evaluate creative quality, audience response, campaign performance, and team delivery.

We will establish specific milestones together based on organizational priorities and available resources.

Working at Unseen

You will report to the COO and work closely with the CEO on brand direction and creative standards. Within approved organizational priorities and brand strategy, you will lead creative recommendations and day-to-day marketing decisions.

Our team works remotely across multiple locations. This role requires regular overlap with Central Time business hours and travel for selected events. Two team meetups per year are encouraged.

The salary range is $75,000 to $95,000, depending on experience and demonstrated capabilities.

You will have flexibility, meaningful creative responsibility, access to global partners and powerful stories of hope, and the opportunity to help organizations change lives for generations.

How to apply

Please submit your resume or professional background, plus:

1. Two examples of campaigns or major creative projects you led. Include the objective, your role, the team or agency involved, approximate budget, and results. At least one should demonstrate fundraising impact.

2. A short note explaining why this opportunity interests you and what you would bring to Unseen.

3. An intro video highlighting who you are and what makes you the best fit to join this team.

Links, existing case studies, and concise summaries are welcome. You may anonymize confidential information. We are interested in the quality of your judgment and contribution, not the polish of your application.

Candidates who advance will discuss their work with our leadership team and participate in a focused creative leadership exercise.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $95,000.00 per year

* Please write a short note explaining why this opportunity interests you and what you would bring to Unseen.
* Please include a link to a short intro video highlighting who you are and what makes you the best fit for this team.

description:
**Organizational Overview**

The National Center on Domestic Violence, Trauma, and Mental Health (NCDVTMH) is a federally funded national resource center providing training and technical assistance; policy analysis and development; research and evaluation; and public awareness. NCDVTMH’s work is survivor-defined and rooted in principles of social justice. It is guided by the experiences of domestic and sexual violence survivors and their families, up-to-date research, and by an intersectional analysis of how systems impact the lives of survivors. Our work emphasizes the realities faced by marginalized communities and is aligned with the broader anti-violence movement.

**Position Description**

The Communications Coordinator will carry out NCDVTMH’s day-to-day communications and dissemination activities, ensuring that our resources, trainings, and messages reach the field accurately, consistently, and on schedule. This is a part-time, non-exempt staff position of 20 hours per week. This role reports to the Operations Manager, who provides day-to-day supervision and management. The Director sets NCDVTMH’s strategic communications plan and approves written content before dissemination. This position is remote within Illinois.

**Core Duties:**

* **Newsletter and Contact List Management:** Write, produce, and distribute NCDVTMH’s monthly newsletter and manage contact list.
* **Social media:** Manage NCDVTMH’s Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn accounts by creating, scheduling, and posting content, engaging with partner organizations, and growing our audience.
* **Campaigns: Support** planning and implement two annual social media campaigns (October and May), including content calendars, graphics, and post-campaign summaries.
* **Director statements:** Disseminate the Director’s statements to NCDVTMH’s email list, social media channels, and media contacts.
* · **Ensure content approval prior to dissemination:** Implement the Director’s communications plan and route written content to the Director for review, editing, and approval before dissemination.
* **Webinars:** Provide post-webinar follow-up, including posting recordings and related materials to the website and distributing them to participants and partners.
* **Product design:** Lead product design and visual production, including creating designs for staff who need design support and reviewing and refining staff-created designs (primarily in Canva) for quality, brand consistency, and accessibility before dissemination.
* **Online resource library:** Upload new NCDVTMH products and descriptions to the website’s resource library and ensure they are accurate, accessible, and easy to find.
* **Website:** Keep website content accurate and current, add new pages as needed, and serve as the primary point of contact for NCDVTMH’s contracted webmaster, who handles technical maintenance, software updates, backups, and security.
* **Analytics and reporting:** Gather and organize web, newsletter, and social media analytics and prepare communications data for federal grant reporting.
* **Collaboration:** Work with NCDVTMH staff, partners, and consultants to meet project timelines and adapt content into accessible formats for different audiences.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

The Communications Coordinator will bring strong writing, editing, and organizational skills; working knowledge of social media, email marketing, and website content management; and strong graphic design skills in Canva. title: DIRECTOR, SOCIAL, INFLUENCERS & COMMUNITY
description:

This role is responsible for leading Jack in the Box's Social, Influencer & Community function, building a distinctive social presence that strengthens brand relevance, sparks cultural conversation, deepens fan relationships, and brings the brand's personality to life. Oversees strategy and execution for organic social, influencer and creator marketing, community management, social listening, and social-first content. Partners with Brand Marketing, Creative, Media & Performance Communications, PR & Partnerships, Digital & Growth, Marketing Insights & Analytics, and agency partners to translate integrated marketing ideas into engaging, shareable social experiences that invite participation. Leads the development and execution of Jack in the Box's organic social strategy across relevant platforms and communities. Defines the role of social within the broader Integrated Communications and Marketing strategy.

Continuously evaluates new platforms, formats, behaviors, communities, and emerging social trends.

Partners closely with Creative and Brand Marketing to translate larger brand ideas into compelling social executions.

Develops original social ideas that can begin in social and extend into broader brand and communications opportunities.

Identifies opportunities to experiment with emerging formats, platform features, memes, trends, creators, and new forms of storytelling.

Establishes clear creative standards while enabling the organization to move at the speed required by social culture.

***Influencer & Creator Marketing***

Leads Jack in the Box's influencer and creator strategy, building an ecosystem of creators who can credibly extend the brand into culture and relevant communities.

Develops approaches across creator partnerships, product seeding, campaign activations, always-on creator relationships, and emerging talent.

Partners with creators to develop content that feels authentic to their channels while unmistakably delivering the Jack in the Box brand.

Establishes clear objectives, briefs, deliverables, guardrails, contracts, and measurement standards for creator programs.

Evaluates creator performance and continuously optimizes the mix of creators, platforms, formats, and investments.

***Community Management & Fan Engagement***

Leads Jack in the Box's approach to community management across social platforms.

Builds stronger relationships with existing fans while creating reasons for new audiences.

Develops proactive strategies for engaging in comments, conversations, trends, fan content, and culturally relevant moments.

Identifies opportunities to recognize, reward, surprise, and activate highly engaged fans and communities.

Maintains a deep understanding of social culture, internet behavior, emerging conversations, creators, entertainment, food culture, and platform trends.

Translates social and cultural signals into actionable opportunities for the brand.

Develops processes, decision rights, and guardrails that enable the team to respond quickly to relevant cultural moments.

Partners with PR, Brand, Creative, Partnerships, and Media to identify social ideas with potential to become larger cultural moments.

Helps the broader organization understand emerging consumer language, behaviors, conversations, and cultural shifts visible through social channels.

***Integrated Communications***

Serves as the social, influencer, and community leader within the Integrated Communications team.

Partners with Brand Marketing, Media, PR, Partnerships, and Creative to develop connected communications plans around major Marketing initiatives.

Brings platform behaviors, creator opportunities, community insights, and cultural context into the development of integrated campaigns.

Partners with Media & Performance Communications to identify opportunities for paid amplification of high-performing social and creator content.

Establishes clear objectives and KPIs for social, influencer, creator, and community programs. Partners with Marketing Insights & Analytics to evaluate program effectiveness and develop consistent measurement practices.

Evaluates performance across content, platforms, creators, campaigns, communities, and formats.

Balances quantitative performance metrics with broader indicators of cultural relevance, community health, and brand impact.

Uses insights to continuously improve content, creator selection, platform strategy, community engagement, and investment.

Builds strong relationships across Creative, Brand, Media, PR, Partnerships, Digital, Analytics, Legal, and agency teams.

Leads with conviction and can advocate for bold ideas in a complex organization.

Deep expertise in organic social strategy, content development, influencer and creator marketing, and community management.

title: Account Director
description:
**Salary range: $100,000-120,000**

tmp helps B2B marketing leaders create coherence in a chaotic world. We’re looking for obsessively curious people to join us.

You'll join 300 B2B experts across strategy, data, creative, media, client services, Sales activation, and shared services. Different skills brought together in integrated teams, centred around our clients: the world’s most impactful tech companies.

So, if you’re interested in what makes the world work, if you find solving complex problems fun, and you love making the answers as simple as possible, then we’d love to hear from you.

**What we are looking for**

We’re looking for an experienced Account Director who combines a passion for marketing with the confidence to lead. This role is pivotal to the success and health of our client partnerships. You’ll take ownership of one or more major accounts, driving excellence in client management, team leadership, and delivery.

Across your accounts, you’ll build strong relationships with your clients, providing advice on marketing strategy and recommending marketing solutions to specific business challenges. Whilst you will work on a variety of clients and integrated marketing programs, a thorough understanding and experience managing integrated media solutions for clients is needed to be successful in this role. Under your direction, tmp will deliver head-turning, results-driven campaigns for your accounts.

You’ll be accountable for an annual revenue target of $3M, ensuring your accounts are profitable, healthy, and positioned for growth. Client satisfaction, commercial success, and the development of your team will all sit within your remit. To deliver at this level, you’ll continually deepen your understanding of marketing best practice, your clients’ industries, and the broader landscape while always looking for opportunities where TMP can add more value.

This is a role for someone who thrives on responsibility, inspires confidence, and leads with TMP’s values. You’ll be entrepreneurial in growing opportunities, resilient when challenges arise, human in how you connect, bold in pushing ideas further, and always looking to bring the magic back to B2B marketing.

**What you will do**

**Client leadership**

* Lead and inspire teams to manage client relationships with excellence, ensuring we not only meet but anticipate client needs.
* Build and maintain strong partnerships with senior client stakeholders (Manager, Director, and beyond), positioning tmp as a trusted advisor.
* Shape and challenge marketing strategy, helping clients to connect their business objectives to tmp’s integrated solutions.
* Provide clear, confident recommendations on the level of investment required to achieve ambitious goals.
* Translate results into meaningful impact, communicating outcomes in a way that secures long-term commitment and funding for future projects and campaigns.

* Critically review and refine strategic, conceptual, and creative outputs, raising the bar on quality and ensuring alignment to the brief and overall strategy.
* Collaborate seamlessly across global clients and teams, adapting to cultural nuances and ways of working to ensure tmp delivers with impact and consistency worldwide.

**Commercial management**

* Take full ownership for converting opportunities that are right for the client and commercially healthy and profitable for tmp.
* Be accountable for accurate and timely Scopes of Work across your accounts that balance ambition with realistic delivery and manage risks before they become blockers.
* Lead forecasting across your accounts, remain accountable for ensuring revenue projections are accurate and programs remain on track.
* Act decisively to resolve commercial issues that could impact profitability or growth.
* Contribute to overall growth targets and commercial reviews, using your insight to shape the wider business picture.
* Invest wisely in client development activity, balancing cost with opportunity and scale.

**Marketing strategy**

* Develop a deep understanding of your client’s business, industry and the work, using this insight to inform all aspects of your oversight, perspective and direction.
* Provide recommendations for marketing solutions that deliver measurable impact on the business objectives of your clients.
* Use your deep expertise across tmp’s full service offering to add value to every client conversation.
* Bring a challenger mindset by asking the questions that elevate thinking and push strategies further.
* Capture success stories across your accounts and share them widely, helping your teams and peers see what “great” looks like.

**Business development**

* Own and lead on the develop of account plans and growth strategies, turning plans into action and rallying your team around them.
* Proactively spot and convert opportunities that expand tmp’s impact and create long-term value.
* Expand and deepen client contact networks, nurturing advocates and alumni who help us open new doors.
* Play a central role in pitches and RFPs, bringing your insight, experience, and leadership presence to the table.
* Be entrepreneurial in your approach, resilient in the face of challenges, and human in the way you lead growth conversations.

**Mentorship and management**

* Set the standard for best practice account management, acting as a role model for the wider team.

* Create a positive, high-performing team culture where people feel supported, motivated, and proud of the work they deliver.

* Ensure new hires are onboarded with confidence, connected to our culture, and set up to thrive.

* A collaborative problem solver who guides and supports your team while staying open to new ideas and perspectives.

title: Head of Performance Video
description:
### **Description**

**About Rho**  
  
Rho Nutrition was founded to bring integrity and innovation to supplement manufacturing by prioritizing medically studied, high-quality formulations. Our products feature clinically proven ingredients using next-generation bio-delivery technologies to enhance cellular-level absorption and drive measurable health benefits. Founded with the vision to deliver unparalleled cellular absorption, we focus on transparency, effectiveness, and empowering individuals to understand and optimize their supplementation. Rho is committed to advancing the science behind wellness and helping customers invest in their health with efficacy-driven solutions. Operating across Shopify DTC, Amazon, and national retail, Rho serves hundreds of thousands of customers and is scaling rapidly while maintaining our strict standards.

**Role Overview**  
  
We’re hiring a Head of Performance Video to lead Rho’s video editing department. You’ll manage and develop our editors, own the quality and delivery of their work, and personally edit performance video.

Reporting to the VP of Creative and Growth and working directly with the founder, you’ll turn creative briefs and direction into effective ads. You’ll lead day-to-day editing, give clear feedback, solve problems in the work, and keep projects moving from raw footage to final delivery.

You’ll stay hands-on, owning edits yourself while helping the team improve. You’ll also contribute to creative strategy discussions and use performance results to sharpen editorial decisions, ensuring the intended audience, message, and testing objective carry through into every cut.

**What You'll Own**  
  
**Lead and develop the video team**

* Manage, coach, and grow a team of video editors, including hiring, onboarding, regular one-to-ones, and performance development.
* Set clear expectations for quality, ownership, and delivery. Give specific, constructive feedback that helps editors become stronger creative thinkers.
* Plan assignments around team capacity and individual strengths, with clear priorities and coverage when people are unavailable.
* Build a collaborative environment where people can contribute ideas, ask questions early, and raise problems before they affect delivery.

**Edit hands-on and lead editorial quality**

* Personally edit priority ads from raw footage through final delivery, including creator, expert, founder, podcast, and product content. Maintain your own editing workload alongside team leadership.
* Find the strongest moments in the footage and build clear, persuasive stories around them. Make thoughtful decisions about hooks, structure, pacing, product explanation, proof, and calls to action.
* Preserve each creator’s voice, personality, and natural delivery. Know when a simple phone video needs restraint and when a produced piece benefits from more craft.
* Use B-roll, graphics, captions, sound, and AI tools deliberately. Every element should help the viewer understand or believe the message.
Review the team’s edits before stakeholder review, give precise notes, and demonstrate solutions directly in the timeline. Partner with Design on typography, composition, and motion standards.  

**Own the editing workflow and delivery**

* Own the editing pipeline from brief and footage review through revisions, quality checks, and delivery. Confirm that each editor understands the direction and deliverables before work begins.
* Flag missing footage or unclear direction early, and work with Creative Strategy, Production, and Partnerships to resolve gaps.
* Work with Creative Operations to keep priorities, owners, deadlines, review status, and launch handoffs clear. Consolidate feedback and proactively resolve blockers.
* Build repeatable standards for project files, naming, version control, and searchable footage libraries so editors can find and reuse strong material.
Coordinate with science, compliance, and partner teams on approved claims, disclosures, and usage permissions. Ensure final assets meet the relevant channel specifications.  

**Contribute to strategy and apply performance learnings**

* Work with the VP of Creative and Growth and creative strategists to understand each brief’s audience, angle, message, and test objective. Ensure those choices are carried through in the edit.
* Contribute ideas in creative reviews, including stronger openings, alternative story structures, useful footage, and opportunities for new cuts. Bring an editor’s perspective to briefing and shoot planning.
* Review ad performance with Creative Strategy and Paid Media. Understand hook rate, hold rate, CTR, conversion rate, CPA/CAC, and ROAS, and use the results to inform editing decisions.
* Turn agreed learnings into purposeful iterations, such as a clearer product explanation, stronger proof, a different opening, or a tighter story. Help editors understand what each version is testing.
* Share patterns from winning and underperforming edits with the team. Evaluate results in context, including spend and campaign objective, and connect attention metrics with conversion outcomes.

  

### **What You'll Bring**

  

* Relevant experience editing performance video at a consumer brand or an agency serving consumer brands is required. You must have directly worked on paid social advertising, with strong experience creating video for Meta.
* Proven experience managing and developing video editors**.** You’ve owned team output, improved creative quality, and helped people become more capable and independent.
* Excellent hands-on editing skills in Premiere Pro or comparable software, with the technical depth to coach others on pacing, sound, color, typography, and motion.
* A portfolio of direct-response ads you have personally edited, with a clear explanation of your contribution, the editorial choices you made, and available performance results.
* Strong creative judgment across authentic creator content and polished production, with an understanding of how each earns attention and builds trust.
* A practical understanding of creative strategy and direct-response storytelling, including audience needs, problem and solution framing, product benefits, proof, and offers.
* Strong understanding of advertising performance. You can read creative reports, interpret key metrics in context, and explain how the results should influence the next edit.
* Clear communication and proactive ownership. You can work directly with senior leaders, challenge ideas constructively, and turn feedback into action.
* Experience in supplements, health, wellness, beauty, or another category that requires careful product education is a plus. Experience with TikTok and YouTube creative, expert or athlete talent, and distributed editing teams is also valuable.

### **What Does Success Look Like in This Role**

  

* A team that understands the strategy, receives useful coaching, and delivers stronger work with greater independence.
* Strong edits that accurately execute the creative brief, preserve the talent’s authenticity, and make the product’s relevance clear.
* Evidence that performance learnings are improving hooks, storytelling, and subsequent iterations, in partnership with Creative Strategy and Paid Media.
* Faster turnaround, fewer avoidable revision rounds, and clear visibility into what is ready, blocked, and launching next.
* A hands-on department leader who produces strong work personally and resolves day-to-day editing decisions with confidence.
* You’ll agree goals with the VP of Creative and Growth covering editing quality, reliable output, turnaround, avoidable revision rounds, team development, and the performance of the work.

  

### **Why Join Rho Nutrition**

At Rho Nutrition, you’ll be part of a team that is passionate about helping people live healthier, stronger lives through evidence-based nutrition. We believe great work happens when talented people are empowered to innovate, collaborate, and grow. Joining Rho means contributing to a mission-driven company that values integrity, curiosity, and continuous improvement—while giving you the opportunity to make a real impact on the health and performance of the communities we serve. If you’re motivated by purpose and excited to work alongside people who care deeply about results and relationships, Rho Nutrition is a place where your work truly matters.

  

### **About Rho Nutrition**

We specialize in delivering innovative solutions and exceptional services to meet the diverse needs of our clients. With a strong commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, we strive to exceed expectations and drive success in every project we undertake.

* **Packaging:** titles, thumbnail concepts and briefs, A/B tests, and repackaging decisions informed by CTR, retention and traffic sources.
* **Scripting:** write full scripts when needed, and edit and quality-check every script before Richard films it. Build strong hooks, story structure, pacing, curiosity and payoffs that keep people watching. Deliver the title's promise in a natural voice, with concrete examples and verified claims.
* **Production:** give editors specific feedback from the first cut, set clear standards and make sure each video meets them.
* **Analytics:** review what worked, what didn't and what to change next. Track subscriber growth, views and audience quality alongside the channel's contribution to leads and sales, working with the wider marketing team. Be clear about which results we can attribute to YouTube and where we’re still making assumptions.
* **Team:** hire, onboard and manage editors, designers and writers. Coach people to improve and write procedures and checklists that help the team make good decisions independently.

### **✅ Who will do well here**

You have a deep passion for YouTube (storytelling and psychology), and an understanding of channel growth. You can explain why a topic, format, title, thumbnail or script works: what earns the click, what keeps someone watching and what makes them return. You can turn that understanding into work that performs.

You are excited about taking on ambitious goals and being responsible for the results. You track progress honestly, work out what's holding us back and come with ideas for fixing it. You learn quickly, ask for feedback and change your approach when the evidence calls for it.

Strong business judgment, an understanding of marketing funnels and experience in Infopreneurship, online education or Edutech are major advantages. We’ll weigh that experience heavily. We’ll also consider an exceptional YouTube leader who can learn our audience, offers and funnel quickly.

This is a full-time role for someone who wants to focus on one business and take responsibility for both the creative work and the team.

### **✅ Hiring process**

Application, Zoom call, paid test project, final interview, offer. For your application, share existing work you are allowed to share; no new script or channel audit is required at this stage.

### **✅ How to apply**

Review Richard’s business YouTube channel and browse the other channels/accounts linked there for context.
  
  
**IMPORTANT TO BE CONSIDERED YOU MUST SHARE A 3–5 MINUTE VIDEO COVERING:**

**1. Your background and motivation:** Briefly introduce yourself, your role on the YouTube channels you’ve worked on and the results you’re most proud of. What excites you about this opportunity, and why do you want this particular role working with Richard Yu?

**2. Your growth philosophy:** How do you approach growing a business YouTube channel like ours? Which metrics matter most, and why?

**3. Your read on our channel and your first 30 days:** What are we doing well, and what most needs to improve to reach 200k+ subscribers in six months and average over 100k views per video? Briefly explain your reasoning and what you would focus on in your first 30 days. Tell us what you can judge from the public channel and what you’d need to learn from our analytics or team. One or two meaningful observations are enough.

**4. Your leadership:** What creative teams have you led? Share one brief example of a difficult leadership decision, how you handled it and what happened.

Keep it conversational and focus on what matters most. You don’t need slides, a detailed audit or a strategy deck. We want to understand you, your judgment and how you work. Please check that your Loom link is accessible.

 **Requirements**  

* + - * + - * + **You’ve grown a YouTube channel and can show the results and your contribution.** We strongly prefer experience in business, making money online, finance or startups. We’ll also consider strong results in tech, personal growth, edutainment or entertainment.
              + Deep passion for YouTube and demonstrated understanding of storytelling and channel growth. Show us published long-form work and explain what you contributed.
              + Strong creative judgment across topics, formats, ideation, titles and thumbnails. You can explain why people click, keep watching and return.
              + Deep understanding of a winning script: hooks, narrative structure, pacing, curiosity, clear explanations and satisfying payoffs. Ability and willingness to write complete first-person, talking-head scripts and improve another writer's work.
              + A structured approach to testing: clear hypotheses, useful comparisons, defined success measures and sound interpretation of results.
              + Ownership of goals, metrics and KPIs. Strong command of CTR, average view duration, retention graphs, traffic sources and channel growth metrics, with examples of how you used them to make decisions.
              + Experience managing editors and/or designers, setting clear standards, giving specific feedback and helping people improve.
              + You learn quickly, ask good questions and take direct feedback well. You can get up to speed on a new audience, subject and business model.
              + Strong business judgment and experience with marketing funnels, infopreneurship, online education or edusoftware are highly valued. A record of connecting content to leads or sales is a strong advantage. These are not prerequisites for an exceptional YouTube candidate who can learn this side quickly.
              + Fluent spoken and written English is essential. You must be able to write natural, compelling English scripts and communicate clearly with Richard and the team.
              + Confidence using without over-reliance on AI tools, particularly Claude/Codex. You still take responsibility for the voice, accuracy and claims in the finished work.
              + Full-time availability and at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern working hours.
              + Remote: we welcome candidates across the United States, Canada, the UK, Europe, Mexico, Central America and South America, including Spain, Portugal, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, Brazil, Panama, Colombia, Argentina and Costa Rica. Exceptional candidates elsewhere are also welcome. What matters is strong YouTube judgment, fluent English and reliable overlap with US Eastern working hours.

  
**Benefits**  

* + **A meaningful challenge.** Help grow a brand with audacious goals, including taking our business channel to 200k+ subscribers in six months and averaging over 100k views per video. Your work will directly shape how we reach people, earn their trust and grow the business.
  + **Real ownership and influence.** We value input from everyone, and few things are off-limits to thoughtful questioning. Bring your perspective, question assumptions and propose better approaches. We listen to good reasoning and are willing to change direction when the evidence supports it. Your ideas and what you learn through testing can influence the broader business.
  + **A team invested in your growth.** We want this to be one of the biggest personal and professional growth experiences of your life. You’ll work directly with Richard and the rest of the leadership team, get honest feedback and take on challenges that stretch your thinking, creative judgment and leadership. We set high standards, and we’re here to help you reach them.
  + **$75,000–$150,000 USD annually plus performance bonuses for exceptional results, in a fully remote, full-time role with reliable overlap with US Eastern working hours.**

title: VP, Group Director, Integrated Production
description:
**Company Description**

EVERSANA INTOUCH® is a global, full-service marketing agency network serving the life sciences industry, and is the first – and only – agency network to be part of a fully integrated commercialization platform through EVERSANA®. We provide next-generation creative and media services, enterprise solutions and data analytics services for clients.

We get fired up when people talk about getting—and staying—healthy. That’s where we find our inspiration: in the very human experiences of patients, doctors, and even each other. Then, we collaborate on ways to make caring for one’s health more achievable, connecting patients and physicians with the information and tools they need.

We embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs.

 **Job Description**

**WHAT DOES A VP, GROUP DIRECTOR, INTEGRATED PRODUCTION DO?**

The VP, Group Director, Integrated Production oversees the Integrated Creative Production and teams. This role is responsible for the success, direction, motivation and financial impact of Integrated Creative Production which includes: video, broadcast, print, social content, art buying, emerging production, event production, AR/VR production and post-production (MGFX & editing) services both in terms of delivering on time and budget for clients as well as achieving creative excellence in tandem. Provides leadership and expert knowledge of the talent, techniques, and technology necessary to execute the work to the highest standards.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**  
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

* Functions as a lead Producer on large scale and high visibility production projects as needed
* Experience managing 12+ Producer, MGFX Designers and Editors
* Manages the Integrated Production and Post-Production teams directly
* Educates peers and clients on Integrated Production and Post-Production at EVERSANA INTOUCH
* Manages freelance and external vendor pool
* Manages freelance and contractor’s time and assignments
* Responsible for full team’s billability goals and meeting business needs
* Assigns agency Producers, Motion Graphics Designers and Editors to projects, helping to balance workloads
* Provides estimates and input to estimates as required
* Looks for ways to grow and further develop the department and services for the agency
* Attracts, develops and deploys production talent to ensure the best content and production value possible for the concept and the client.
* Accountable for the overall quality of work, ensuring goals are met and projects delivered on time and on budget.
* Takes a proactive role in business development efforts, helping prepare and present written, video and audio presentations.
* Defines individual goals for direct reports, providing mentorship, and managing performance reviews
* Advise project brand teams and clients on best practices, process, scope, schedules, and pricing, while building strong, resilient relationships along the way.
* Work closely with the Resource Management team and the Executive Producers of each affiliate to manage current workloads and best forecast incoming projects to secure adequate resources.
* Evolve operational processes and workflow documentation, while overseeing all aspects of the project life cycle from concept to delivery.
* Partners with Human Resources to identify and hire new Integrated Production talent, ensuring the department keeps pace with demand as well as recruiting through a lens of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
* Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
* All other duties as assigned

**PEOPLE LEADER**

People leaders must possess both the skills to effectively accomplish these tasks and the emotional intelligence to do so in alignment with our cultural values. In addition to the critical management and leadership tasks listed above, this role also includes the following unique responsibilities:

* Responsible for and oversee their respective department.
* Interview, select and supervise the activities of the department staff; communicate interpret and discuss with team the company policies and procedures.
Determine job objectives, work methods and performance standards; review performance relative to departmental objectives discussion appraisal with each employee and performance; authorize and communicate salary changes, promotions, transfers, discipline, and discharge and administer all other personnel actions.  

  
  
**Qualifications**

**WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?**

**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

* 15+ years’ experience in Integrated Production with progressively expanding roles in an advertising agency environment.
* Extensive understanding of the video and print production, motion graphics and video editing process, proactively educating others as needed.
* Confident at estimating hours and out-of-pocket costs on production related requests.
* Proven experience implementing solutions that deliver services with high-quality standards in a profitable and sustainable manner.
* Demonstrated experience working with and successfully hiring, managing, motivating, and developing team members.
* Comfortable with developing internal training materials and resources that support team/individual growth and development.
* Experience auditing and redesigning Integrated Production process and workflows.
* Stays on the edge of Emerging Production trends, integrating them into EVERSANA INTOUCH’s offerings as needed.
* Proficient in delegating tasks appropriately, providing guidance and support to ensure smooth project execution.
* Client facing experience
* Change management experience.
* Strong written and presentation skills.
* Exceptionally results-driven, responsible, and accountable.
* Eager to grow and continue to improve Integrated Production and Post-Production offerings at EVERSANA INTOUCH.
* Solid business acumen and problem-solving skills.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and guide creative and production teams.
* Extensive conflict resolution skills and experience

  
**Additional Information**

**OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:**

**Patient Minded** I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

**Client Delight** I own every client experience and its impact on results.

**Take Action** I am empowered and empower others to act now.

**Grow Talent** I own my development and invest in the development of others.

**Win Together** I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

**Communication Matters** I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.

**Embrace Diversity** I create an environment of awareness and respect.

**Always Innovate** I am bold and creative in everything I do.

Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.

EVERSANA is committed to providing competitive salaries and benefits for all employees. If this job posting includes a base salary range, it represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position and is not applicable to locations outside of the U.S. Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, other job-related qualifications/skills, and geographic location (to account for comparative cost of living). This role is eligible for hire in select U.S. locations based on business and operational considerations. For a full list of locations, visit eversana.com/careers. More information about EVERSANA’s benefits package can be found at eversana.com/careers. EVERSANA reserves the right to modify this base salary range and benefits at any time.

From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, it is the policy of EVERSANA to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by a qualified applicant or candidate with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship for EVERSANA. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodations applies to all aspects of the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the interview and hiring process, please contact us at applicantsupport@eversana.com.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
****🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!****
Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.
  
  
As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.
  
  
We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a strategic and inspiring Director of Product Design to lead our Buyer Design team, the group responsible for shaping the end-to-end experience for millions of users navigating our platform.
  
  
As the design leader overseeing the entire buyer journey, you'll drive the strategy and execution for everything from customer acquisition, activation, to retention and re-engagement. This includes onboarding, discovery surfaces (browse, search, ranking, personalization, taxonomy), the live shopping experience, customer service, our games team, and customer service flows.
  
  
You’ll be a true player-coach, equally comfortable building and developing a high-performing design team as you are rolling up your sleeves and doing the work yourself. You’ll help shape the team, establish clear career paths, mentor designers, and create an environment where people can grow and do their best work.
  
  
As a leader, you’ll help define the design strategy and set a clear vision for what our experiences can become, partnering closely with product, engineering, research, and business teams to turn that vision into a roadmap for the team.
  
  
As a practitioner, you’ll stay close to the work. You’ll move fluidly from defining the long-term experience vision to tackling specific product and feature-level design challenges - exploring concepts, prototyping ideas, and helping bring the details to life. This role is for someone who can lead through both direction and craft, knowing when to empower the team and when to jump in and design alongside them.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and scale a high-performing team of product designers across the buyer funnel.
* Define and drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the buyer experience in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
* Partner with research, data, and product to develop deep customer empathy and inform high-impact design decisions.
* Shape intuitive, elegant systems across discovery, live shopping, and post-purchase experiences.
* Ensure our experiences are accessible, inclusive, and delightfully human.
* Champion design quality and consistency across surfaces while enabling speed and iteration.
* Nurture a strong design culture through mentorship, feedback, and high standards for craft and thinking.
* Represent design in executive conversations and influence company-wide priorities.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years leading teams.
* A player-coach mindset-excited to mentor, but equally passionate about designing and solving problems hands-on.
* Strong portfolio showcasing interaction and visual design skills, with a track record of shipping successful products.
* Proven success designing and scaling customer-facing experiences across a complex funnel (acquisition through retention).
* Deep expertise in interaction design, systems thinking, and user-centered design.
* Strong understanding of search, discovery, personalization, and taxonomy design principles.
* Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, or live shopping platforms is a major plus.
* A strong collaborator who thrives at the intersection of product, business, and user needs.
* A portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, elegant solutions to complex problems.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**
You’ll help define how the next generation of users discover, shop, and engage with sellers and communities they love. You’ll work alongside a passionate and ambitious team that values joy, experimentation, and deep customer empathy. And you’ll help build a design culture where creativity and performance go hand in hand.
  
  
If you’re an experienced design leader who loves craft, strategy, and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
****Reporting Structure****
Jon Malkemus - VP of Design
  
  
**Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. If you see an email impersonating a Whatnot recruiter, please disregard and report it as spam.**
****💛 EOE****
Whatnot is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce.
  
  
Compensation Range: $310K - $365K
